title: Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photog
prompt:
Ultra-realistic candid smartphone photograph, 9:16 vertical.
Use the attached image only as a strong visual inspiration for general facial proportions and vibe,
while ensuring the generated subject remains fully original, non-identifiable, and not a face copy.
Scene
Nighttime on a quiet Tokyo city sidewalk beside a building with white ceramic tile walls.
The subject is walking past the camera, partially side-on, captured mid-step in a rushed, accidental moment.
Poses & Gestures (combined naturally)
The subject reacts instinctively to being photographed:
turning her head back mid-walk as if surprised,
raising one hand close to the lens to partially block the camera,
shy, restrained smile forming as she suppresses laughter,
body angled in half-profile while continuing to walk forward,
motion carries her slightly out of frame, imperfect framing.
Expressions are subtle and spontaneous — embarrassed, playful, fleeting — never posed.
Camera & Motion
Shot on a modern smartphone, handheld, rushed capture. Strong uncontrolled camera shake. Heavy directional motion blur across the raised hand, hair, and face. Facial features appear smeared and streaked by movement, faintly recognizable but distorted. Partial ghosting around the body. Imperfect framing, subject nearly leaving the frame.
Lighting
Flash-only lighting fired mid-motion. Harsh flash highlights on skin and hand. Deep surrounding darkness. Uneven exposure, blown highlights, hard shadows typical of hurried night phone photography.
Background
White ceramic tile wall stretches into streaked light bands due to motion blur. Street surroundings fade into darkness with minimal readable detail.
Mood
Candid, shy, slightly playful. Feels intrusive, raw, imperfect, and authentic — like a fleeting memory accidentally captured and never meant to be perfect.
Image Quality
Extremely noisy. Heavily blurred. Raw smartphone look. Not cinematic. Not editorial. Not polished.
Negative Prompt
anime, illustration, painting, stylized,
studio lighting, beauty lighting, soft portrait,
sharp focus, clean face, perfect anatomy, smooth skin,
fashion editorial, posed portrait, cinematic grading, film still,
tripod shot, professional photography,
identity match, face copy, real person replication

Create the third image of the unified brand visual system for “OZOUO” fruit drinks, keeping exactly the same brand identity, mascot style, typography, packaging language, can proportion, and overall visual DNA as the established OZOUO 225ml lychee drink system. This image must have a different responsibility from the packaging design board and the flavor-family poster: it is a lifestyle campaign application board / brand rollout collage / launch communication visual.

Core role:
This image should present how the OZOUO brand lives in the real world through a multi-scene campaign collage. It should feel like a launch-ready marketing board that shows product beauty shots, lifestyle use, merchandising, and outdoor brand impact, all within one coherent poster. The image must clearly belong to the same OZOUO brand system, not a different brand.

Overall composition:
Use a clean multi-panel collage layout inspired by a modern FMCG launch board. Arrange the composition in 4 sections with strong visual clarity and breathing room:
top section: hero can lineup / product beauty shot
middle left: lifestyle drinking moment
middle right: branded merchandising or gift box / retail display scene
bottom section: bold outdoor campaign or oversized billboard / street poster application
The whole image should feel clean, stylish, youthful, and commercially convincing.

Brand consistency:
Keep exactly the same OZOUO system from the existing reference:
same “OZOUO” wordmark
same 225ml compact can proportion
same lychee flavor hero design
same adult-oriented cartoon lychee mascot
same creamy neutral base and lychee-pink accent palette
same premium FMCG realism
same slogan language such as “PEEL THE MOOD”
same balance between cute and grown-up
The image must feel like a natural continuation of the same brand universe.

Flavor focus:
Keep lychee as the hero flavor to maintain continuity. The can design, fruit visuals, mascot, and tone should stay aligned with the established lychee packaging system. The hero can should appear fresh, cold, and premium, with realistic condensation and polished aluminum texture.

Scene 1, top section:
Show two or three OZOUO 225ml lychee cans in a product beauty composition. They can be standing and lying down on a clean surface, with condensation droplets, realistic shadows, and a fresh premium feel. Keep the styling minimal, not cluttered. This scene should showcase the can as a real product hero.

Scene 2, middle left:
Show a real lifestyle moment of a person drinking OZOUO lychee. Only partial figure or cropped portrait is needed. The person should feel young adult, stylish, modern, and brand-appropriate. The can remains clearly visible. The mood should feel refreshing, social-media friendly, and natural, not like a generic stock photo.

Scene 3, middle right:
Show OZOUO brand extension into a compact merch or retail-display scene, such as stacked branded gift boxes, point-of-sale display cubes, or small launch-kit packaging in the same visual system. The boxes should use the same mascot, same typography, same lychee color palette, and same clean branding language. This section proves the brand system can expand beyond the can.

Scene 4, bottom section:
Show a bold outdoor campaign application: an oversized OZOUO lychee can mural, billboard, or wall poster in an urban setting. Keep it clean and graphic, with a giant can or giant slogan displayed on a wall, poster board, or branded street-facing surface. Add one small walking person or urban figure for scale. This section should show the brand’s public presence and visual impact.

Typography:
Typography should be a major brand asset but remain concise and controlled. Use the same OZOUO style as the established system: bold, rounded, adult-friendly, shelf-ready, stylish, and clean.

Include text such as:
“OZOUO”
“LYCHEE JUICE DRINK”
“PEEL THE MOOD”
“轻启一罐，荔刻上头”
“成人向果味灵感”

For the outdoor campaign section, use one short bold slogan such as:
“PEEL THE MOOD”
or
“一罐进入果味状态”

Do not add too much copy. Keep the text strategic, visual, and brand-consistent.

Visual style:
The whole board should feel like a polished launch campaign presentation for a modern fruit drink startup:
clean,
graphic,
adult playful,
social-media ready,
retail-ready,
brand-cohesive,
stylish,
fresh,
premium,
commercially believable.
It should not feel like four unrelated images. All scenes must be tied together by the same color system, can design, typography, mascot style, and tone of voice.

Color palette:
Use the established OZOUO lychee palette:
creamy warm beige,
soft blush pink,
lychee rose,
berry-pink accents,
deep espresso-brown typography,
small fresh green leaf accents.
The campaign board should feel consistent and recognizable as the same brand family.

Rendering:
hyper-detailed 225ml can mockups, realistic lifestyle photography, polished merch mockups, branded outdoor application, soft studio shadows, clean composition, premium FMCG campaign presentation, 8k, commercially believable, visually memorable.

Negative prompt:
technical packaging layout repeated, barcode-heavy board, inconsistent can proportions, different mascot style, childish kids drink brand, messy collage, random backgrounds, weak brand identity, too many flavors, low detail, generic stock-photo ad, unrelated urban billboard design

title: Create an ultra-vibrant commercial poste
prompt:
Create an ultra-vibrant commercial poster for M&M’s chocolate candies, featuring a highly realistic mini M&M’s tube package at the exact center as the absolute hero object. The image should combine one realistic product with an explosive hand-drawn illustrated background, creating a youthful, saturated, energetic, and extremely lively candy campaign poster.

Main composition:
Place one realistic mini M&M’s tube package exactly at the center of the image. The package should be a slim portable candy tube, compact and upright, with a rounded cap and a clean cylindrical body, clearly designed as a mini snack tube for M&M’s. It must feel highly realistic, glossy, tactile, and instantly recognizable, with vivid M&M’s logo, colorful branding, premium printed label wrap, sharp reflections, and strong commercial product rendering. The mini tube should be the only fully realistic object in the composition and must dominate the center.

Packaging direction:
The tube should feel playful, portable, collectible, and snackable, like a convenient mini candy tube sold at retail checkout counters. The cap can be bold red, yellow, blue, or white. The body should clearly show M&M’s identity and may include a transparent section revealing colorful candies inside, or a bright fully printed wrapper with bold brand graphics. The tube should feel modern, cute, and highly display-friendly.

Background concept:
Behind the mini tube, create an explosive illustrated universe that radiates outward like a burst of candy energy. The background should not be realistic. Instead, it should be a dense, dynamic, hand-drawn graphic world made of bold black outlines, candy splashes, bounce arcs, swirls, pop-art shapes, looping doodles, comic impact bursts, and rhythmic motion graphics. The illustration should erupt from behind the tube and wrap around it in a circular energetic explosion.

Illustrated elements:
Build the illustrated background from M&M’s-inspired candy energy:
flying colorful chocolate beans in red, yellow, blue, green, orange, and brown,
candy trails,
sugar splash shapes,
confetti,
comic impact bursts,
lightning bolts,
stars,
hearts,
bounce curves,
looping lines,
speech-bubble icons,
playful smiley doodles,
cheerful motion marks,
curved wave forms,
mini balloons,
striped speed lines,
roller-skate energy,
fun geometric symbols.
The illustrations should feel premium, bold, rhythmic, and highly art-directed, not messy childish scribbles.

Style contrast:
The mini tube must feel solid, glossy, realistic, and sharply rendered, while the illustrated universe behind it feels wild, colorful, playful, and explosive. This contrast between realism and hand-drawn candy chaos is the key visual hook. The product remains the visual anchor at all times.

Color palette:
Use a highly saturated M&M’s palette:
bright candy red,
electric blue,
sunny yellow,
vivid green,
orange,
chocolate brown,
clean white highlights,
and bold black line work.
Choose one strong dominant background field color such as vivid sky blue, rich yellow, or bright red, then let the multicolor candy illustration explode around the central mini tube.

Motion and energy:
The poster must feel like candy energy is bursting outward from the mini tube with bounce, swirl, pop, splash, spin, and playful impact. The overall mood should be dynamic, joyful, fast, pop, and impossible to ignore.

Typography:
Keep typography concise and energetic, placed cleanly without cluttering the composition. Use playful premium lettering, rounded and graphic, not ugly heavy black fonts.

Include text such as:
“M&M’s”
“MINI TUBE, MAX FUN”
“POP THE COLOR”
“SHAKE. SNAP. PLAY.”

Optional artistic Chinese text:
“M&M’s 玛氏巧克力豆”
“迷你小管装”
“小小一管，快乐爆开”
“随手一拿，彩色开玩”

Keep text short, bold, youthful, and balanced with the central tube and illustrated explosion.

Mood:
playful, saturated, dynamic, youthful, colorful, pop-art, joyful, energetic, collectible, premium, unforgettable.

Rendering:
hyper-detailed realistic mini candy tube packaging, glossy rounded cap, premium label texture, vivid brand graphics, optional visible candies inside, bold hand-drawn doodle illustration, saturated clean colors, crisp black outlines, premium poster composition, 8k, high-end commercial candy campaign quality.

Negative prompt:
soft pouch packaging, cardboard box, plastic jar, glass jar, metal tin, large family pack, realistic background scene, dull colors, weak motion, cluttered messy layout, low saturation, generic snack ad, blurry product, cheap cartoon style, muddy colors, flat composition, too much text, weak M&M’s branding, dark moody atmosphere

title: Edit the uploaded photo and don't change
prompt:
Edit the uploaded photo and don't change the face, portrait 9:16, no blur, HD, 8K. A monochrome editorial-style portrait collage featuring a young woman in a minimalist indoor studio setting. The composition is arranged as a 2x3 grid of six frames, each capturing different intimate, relaxed, and fashion-forward poses. The overall mood is sensual, cinematic, and timeless, inspired by classic black-and-white magazine portrait photography with soft natural light and subtle film grain. Her hair is waist length, deep ash gray brown. Korean long hush layers cut. Thin bangs see-through long bangs. Soft face framing front layer. Hair is made straight and sleek with a slight flip at the ends. Silky glossy texture with a little natural flyaway hair. Dewy clean skin. Natural fluffy brows. Soft brown eyeliner, mascara. Nude matte lips. Minimal blush. Fresh understated beauty look. She wears white ribbed fitted tank top. High-waisted baggy vintage washed jeans (partially shown in some frames). Black matte nail art. Accessories include multiple silver rings, silver thin watch, and small hoop earrings, adding an edgy editorial touch.

Poses (Collage Breakdown) :
1. Close-up portrait with hand gently touching cheek, direct eye contact, soft intense gaze

2. Relaxed seated pose on a sofa, body slightly angled, looking away thoughtfully

3. Reclining pose with one knee raised, leaning into arm, sensual editorial posture

4. Hands raised behind head, relaxed confident expression, slightly leaning back

5. Soft portrait with head tilted, eyes closed, calm emotional mood

6. Straight-on seated pose, composed expression, subtle movement in hair for natural feel.
Minimal indoor studio setting. Plain light-colored wall. Neutral sofa partially visible in some frames. 

Soft shadows adding depth without distraction. Shot with Canon EOS R5 / Sony A7R IV (or similar professional mirrorless camera). Mostly eye-level portrait angles. Occasional slight high-angle for softness and intimacy. Tight close-ups mixed with medium shots for variety. Rule-of-thirds composition in most frames. Editorial framing designed for magazine layout collage. Soft natural diffused studio lighting. Even illumination with gentle shadows on one side of the face. Slight backlight separation for hair definition. No harsh flash, very soft cinematic contrast. Black and white film conversion. Soft contrast with lifted shadows. Fine film grain texture (35mm analog feel). Slight matte finish with reduced blacks. High detail in skin texture but smooth tonal blending. Inspired by vintage fashion magazine editorial photography.

title: 朝光の白
prompt:
主題：
朝光の白

主体：
木枠の大きなガラス戸の前で、庭から差し込む朝日を受けながら外を眺める成人女性の後ろ姿を中心にした、静かな縦長ポートレート。

人物・表情：
自然で現実感のある成人女性。髪は低めのラフなシニヨンにまとめ、首元と耳の横に細い後れ毛が落ちている。顔はほとんど見せず、少しだけ右側へ向けた横顔の気配を残す。視線は開いたガラス戸の外、庭の明るい方へ向ける。肩の力を抜き、朝の空気を吸い込む直前のような静かな佇まい。

服装・ポーズ：
淡いアイボリーのロングワンピースに、透け感のある薄いガーゼ素材の羽織を重ねる。背中は大きく開いたデザインだが、内側には肌色に近い自然なインナーを合わせ、上品で生活感のある見え方にする。細い肩紐が背中でゆるく交差し、羽織の袖はふんわり広がる。人物自身の右手は開いた木枠にそっと添え、指先は軽く曲げる。左腕は身体の横に下ろし、薄い布を少しだけ引き寄せる。重心は右足に置き、左足を半歩だけ後ろへ引いて、身体をわずかに斜めへひねる。裾は木の床にやわらかく広がり、朝の風で布の端が少し揺れる。

背景・光：
古い日本家屋を思わせる落ち着いた室内。木の床、細い木枠のガラス戸、右側に薄い白いカーテン、画面奥には小さな庭と低い塀、鉢植え、淡い緑の庭木が見える。光は画面左上の屋外から差し込む柔らかな朝日。背中、肩、羽織の縁を明るく透かし、布の繊維を浮かび上がらせる。室内側は少し暗めで、外の庭は明るいが白飛びしすぎない。床には木枠とカーテンの影が斜めに落ち、ガラスにはごく淡い反射が残る。

構図・カメラ：
縦長構図。人物は中央より少し右寄りに立ち、頭から裾まで全身が入る。ガラス戸の縦線と横線で画面を自然に分割し、人物の背中と開いた戸に視線が集まる構図。カメラは腰より少し高い位置から平視に近く撮影する。人物の上半身と透ける布に焦点を合わせ、庭の木々と塀は柔らかくぼかす。室内の暗さと屋外の朝光の差を活かし、静かな逆光感を保つ。

質感・スタイル：
写真風。肌は自然な質感で、過度な美肌補正をしない。薄いガーゼの繊維、木床のわずかな反射、カーテンの柔らかい影、ガラスの曇りと反射を丁寧に描写する。色はアイボリー、淡いベージュ、木の茶色、庭のやさしい緑を中心にまとめる。全体は落ち着いた朝の空気感で、雑誌写真のように余白のある仕上がり。

ネガティブ：
裸、露骨な性的表現、過度な透け感、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、道具との接触不良、浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

title: A photorealistic lifestyle portrait of a
prompt:
A photorealistic lifestyle portrait of a young East Asian woman seated casually at a retro computer workstation in a cozy apartment bedroom. She is turned slightly away from the desk, glancing back toward the camera with a thoughtful, serene expression that feels spontaneous and unposed. Her long dark hair falls naturally around her face with a few loose strands, and she wears a relaxed cream-colored oversized knit sweater paired with comfortable white lounge shorts, creating a warm, understated look.

The scene is set in a softly cluttered late-night workspace inspired by early internet-era bedrooms. A chunky CRT monitor casts a subtle glow across the desk, displaying a coding interface, surrounded by a classic beige keyboard, wired mouse, scattered notebooks, a steaming mug, and small personal trinkets. The room extends into the background with a partially open door, a wooden chest of drawers, a casually rumpled bed, stacked books, and a simple analog wall clock, adding character and authenticity.

Shot as if captured with a compact point-and-shoot camera using direct flash, the lighting feels intimate and nostalgic, with gentle highlights, realistic skin texture, and soft shadow falloff. Muted vintage tones, subtle color fading, delicate film grain, and tiny imperfections create the feeling of a discovered photograph from the early 2000s. Shallow depth of field keeps focus on the subject while the room softly melts into the background. Vertical composition, cinematic framing, natural storytelling, cozy midnight programming mood, authentic Y2K-inspired atmosphere.

title: 赤い壁と夏の横顔
prompt:
主題：
赤い壁と夏の横顔

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだ自然な肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライトが入り、過度な美肌補正ではなく繊細な肌理を残す。精密で上品なドールライク日系メイク、淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さく澄んだキャッチライト。表情は落ち着いていて、少しクールに遠くを見る。黒茶色の髪をゆるい低めポニーテールにまとめ、顔まわりに細い後れ毛が風で流れる。

服装・ポーズ：
夏らしい軽さのあるアイボリーの細ストラップリブニットキャミソール。鎖骨と肩のラインが自然に見えるが、露出は上品に抑える。ボトムスは生成りベージュのハイウエストワイドパンツ、リネン混の薄手素材で、ウエストに同色の長い布ベルトを結ぶ。足元はブラウンベージュの細ストラップサンダル。人物はテラコッタ色の低い壁の上に斜めに座り、人物自身の右手を壁の上に置いて体を支え、左膝を軽く立て、右脚は下へ自然に伸ばす。上半身は少し画面左へひねり、顔は青空側へ向ける。

背景・光：

title: 緑に溶ける午後
prompt:
主題：
緑に溶ける午後

主体：
縦长3:4的照片。室内的狭小温室般的植物空间中，二十岁出头的女性坐在湿润的木质地板上。人物较大地配置在画面中央稍偏左的位置，上半身到大腿占据了画面的绝大部分。周围被大型观叶植物环绕，前景也加入叶片以营造纵深感。

人物・表情：
自然且具现实感の日系人像。湿润的深棕色长发细细贴在脸颊、颈部和肩膀上，前发略显凌乱地垂落在额头。肌肤明亮，脸颊和嘴唇带有淡淡的血色。眼部采用精致的棕色妆容，长睫毛，以及清澈的捕捉光。脸庞微微侧倾，静静凝视镜头。嘴角未完全闭合，流露出感受到夏日湿度的沉静表情。

服装・ポーズ：
白色至米色的蕾丝边吊带式裁剪上衣。胸口处有小型缎带和垂直垂下的细绳，轻薄的面料因湿润而微微贴合肌肤，但保持在优雅自然的范围内。下装为深蓝色的牛仔短裤。画面左下方的女性左手置于湿润的木质地板上支撑身体，右手轻轻触碰颈边的发丝。上身微微后仰，腰部斜置。一条腿向前景伸展，另一条腿轻弯置于后方。肌肤和衣物上残留细小的水滴。

背景・光：
背景为观叶植物密集的明亮室内花园。可见到龟背竹、黄金葛、大型光泽叶片、藤编花盆罩、窗框，以及湿润的木质地板。不放置现有角色或吉祥物、小动物插图。从右上方深处窗户射入强烈的午后自然光，从叶片间隙投射出在人物头发、肩膀、手臂、腿部闪烁的白色高光。地板上有水面的反射，背景明亮柔和地虚化。

构图・カメラ：
纵向构图，从稍高的视线以近距离拍摄。人物脸部位于上1/3附近，躯干居中，腿部较大地进入下部前景。左侧配置窗框，右侧配置大型叶片，以植物形成自然的画框。焦点置于脸部和上半身，背景与前景的叶片采用浅景深柔和虚化。相当于50mm〜85mm的人像镜头，以专业相机拍摄般的自然压缩感。

质感・スタイル：
真实的照片表现。细致描绘夏日的湿度、湿润的头发、肌肤的水滴、木质地板的反射，以及叶片的润泽。明亮的绿色与米白色、深蓝牛仔的对比。肌肤不过度加工，保留自然的质感。略带高键、透明感十足的日系グラビア风格时尚人像。柔和的胶片颗粒，干净的色调，自然的反光。

负面：
不自然的五官、不自然的视线、多余的手指、缺失的手指、手脚融合、关节破损、衣物破损、过度暴露、道具或地板接触不良、不自然的引力、光源矛盾的阴影、文字乱码、标志、水印、现有角色、吉祥物、过度美肌修饰、塑料般的肌肤。

The background must be clean warm ivory or light beige paper, completely free from texture, patterns, gradients, borders, frames, decorative elements, calligraphy, signatures, watermarks, logos, or any typography. Leave generous negative space surrounding the portrait for a refined gallery presentation.

title: 花影の朝
prompt:
主題：
花影の朝

主体：
縦長のリアル写真作品。白いレースの寝具に横たわる20代前半の成人女性を、画面中央から下方向へ大きく配置する。頭は画面左上寄り、身体は右下へ斜めに流れ、人物が画面全体の約75％を占める。春の庭に置かれた白いベッドの上で、朝の光を浴びながら静かに目覚めるような場面。

人物・表情：
自然で上品な日系メイクの女性。明るいアイボリー系の肌に、頬と鼻先、鎖骨へ柔らかな朝のハイライトが入る。髪は黒に近いダークブラウンのロングヘアで、白い枕の上にゆるく広がる。瞳は少し眠たげにカメラを見つめ、口元は力を抜いた自然な半開き。寝起きの静けさと、朝のまぶしさを感じる表情。

服装・ポーズ：
白い総レースの上品なサマードレス。胸元、腰まわり、太ももまわりは布が重なって自然に覆われ、透けすぎず清潔感のある印象にする。人物自身の右腕は額の上に軽くかざし、手首で朝日を受け止める。左腕は髪のそばでゆるく曲げ、指先が髪に少し触れる。身体は仰向けに近い斜めの姿勢で、手前の脚が画面右下へ大きく前景化し、レースの布が身体のラインに沿って柔らかく重なる。

背景・光：
屋外の花咲く庭。前景には白いレースのシーツ、中景には白い枕と人物、後景には淡いピンク、白、紫の小花と若葉の緑が広がる。朝の低めの光が右上から差し込み、葉の影が顔、腕、ドレス、脚に細かく落ちる。白い布からの反射光で肌を明るく包み、影は淡いグレーと薄いベージュで柔らかく残す。背景の花は大きくぼかし、朝露を含んだような透明感を出す。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図、3:4比率。カメラは人物の足元側から少し高めに寄った近距離ポートレート。顔は左上の三分割付近、右下にはレースと脚の大きな前景を置く。焦点は顔と上半身に合わせ、手前の脚と奥の花は浅い被写界深度で自然にぼかす。斜めに流れる身体、腕の曲線、白い布の重なりで、朝の静かなリズムを作る。

質感・スタイル：

Visible skin includes the face, ears, neck, collarbones, a limited upper-chest area above the neckline, both shoulders, both arms and hands, and the thighs and knees exposed beneath the shorts. The waist, abdomen, back and main chest area remain covered. The skin should appear fine-grained, supple and lightly hydrated, as though the sunlit areas would feel gently warm and smooth while shaded areas retain delicate natural fine hair. Preserve mild color variation around the elbows and knees, small moles and subtle imperfections. Do not apply plastic smoothing.  She wears a fitted warm-white ribbed sleeveless tank top with moderately wide straps and a modest scoop neckline. Add tiny pale-red lettering on the chest, visible ribbed knit texture and natural folds around the waist. The top fully covers the torso and remains opaque. Pair it with light-gray casual shorts, warm-white ribbed knee-high athletic socks and dusty gray-blue retro sneakers with white laces, pale soles and subtle wear creases. Warm sunlight enters from above and slightly front-left, grazing the hair, shoulders, forearms, white tank top and knees with localized bright highlights. Open sky and pale floor tiles provide soft reflected fill so the face remains evenly readable. Keep authentic occlusion shadows beneath the chin, inside the arms, behind the knees and around the chair back. No flash, no artificial rim light and no studio softbox. Maintain moderately deep focus so the subject is clearest but the tables, tiles, pillar and foliage remain recognizable.  The finished image should feel like a friend spontaneously lifted a phone and captured a fleeting summer café moment. She had been chatting a moment earlier; now her fingers are moving toward a heart, and the next second she may laugh because the gesture did not align perfectly. prompt:
任务：为“麒麟西瓜”设计一张高端水果电商包装提案板，主题为“麒夏礼境”，面向城市中高端家庭送礼、企业团购、生鲜电商精品礼盒场景。输出应是一张专业、克制、真实可落地的包装设计 proposal board，而不是普通广告海报。

品牌定位与受众：premium fresh fruit ecommerce gift packaging for Kirin watermelon, restrained luxury agricultural gifting, trustworthy, fresh, premium, modern Chinese aesthetic, audience includes urban families, summer seasonal gifting buyers, enterprise welfare procurement, boutique fresh-food ecommerce consumers.

英雄包装结构：画面中心为一个超大 45-degree hero package，占画面 50% 左右。包装采用“一体式书型翻盖礼盒 + 外部运输护箱”的结构逻辑。礼盒为横向长方体，比例稳重，边角挺括，盖面完整展开后能看到内托与双果位；运输护箱作为次级模块出现在侧边，以较简洁方式展示其抗压、防护与面单区。礼盒提手不要做脆弱挖孔，改为加固织带提手或隐藏式侧提结构。底部结构必须厚实，有锁底或托盘式承重逻辑。整个包装不能显得轻薄廉价，必须有 realistic rigid board and corrugated structure thickness.

水果与内托逻辑：麒麟西瓜为大果重果，方案采用 2果装。内部为双独立果位阵列，使用 molded pulp insert / paper-pulp tray with contour support, each watermelon seated into a shaped cradle, with honeycomb-paper bottom cushion, top stabilizing ring, side anti-roll ribs, clear lid clearance, visible ventilation path. 果实不得悬空，不得互相挤压，不得靠果皮直接承重碰撞。开箱模块中应清楚看到两个果位、限位环、底部缓冲、提取手位和透气孔路径。可以加入单个切面西瓜作为小面积辅助物，强调品类识别，但不能喧宾夺主。

视觉识别系统：整体风格为高端东方农业礼品包装，clean premium packaging board, modern Chinese typography mood, restrained composition. 主色为深墨绿色、玉白色，辅助为淡藤黄色，点缀少量西瓜瓤红与低饱和烫金。图形语言来自“麒麟纹样抽象化 + 西瓜藤蔓曲线 + 夏季风场纹理”，但必须极简、规整、可用于大面积包装，不要传统复杂国潮堆砌。表面材质表现为特种纸裱灰板、局部烫金 logo、局部 UV 产品名、细腻压纹。工艺数量要克制，不超过三种重点效果。纸张纹理、瓦楞边厚度、模塑纸托纤维感都应清晰可见。

提案板构成：使用 clean studio presentation board，浅暖白背景带轻微玉色渐层。除中央英雄包装外，周围以模块化网格排布 7 到 8 个辅助模块：
1. 开箱视图：展示翻盖打开后的双果位内托结构
2. 三视图：正面、侧面、顶部的包装外观小图
3. 内托结构放大：显示纸浆托、蜂窝底垫、顶部限位环、提取手位
4. 运输护箱模块：显示外护箱、面单区、条码区、二维码占位区
5. 刀模结构示意：production-intent dieline visualization，不要伪装成完全可生产文件
6. 材质与工艺 swatches：特种纸、纸浆托、烫金、局部UV、压纹
7. 关键尺寸注释：礼盒外尺寸、单果位净空、提手位置、透气孔避让逻辑
8. 品牌故事小模块：小面积展示“夏季精品瓜礼”的定位语和产地徽记

刀模与生产标注：在右下或下方安排一个可读但不抢戏的 dieline module。使用标准图例表达：红色实线裁切线、蓝色虚线压痕线、绿色出血线、紫色安全线、浅绿色透气孔、浅棕色内托缓冲区域、黄色粘胶位。标注内容要是 clean modular annotations, unit mm, bleed 3 mm, safety margin 5 mm, finished-size tolerance +-1 mm, die-cut tolerance +-0.5 mm, print registration tolerance +-0.3 mm, logistics label zone, barcode placeholder, QR placeholder, traceability code placeholder, batch/date placeholder。注意所有码区都必须是 clearly labeled placeholder zones, not fake readable codes.

灯光与镜头：soft studio lighting, premium commercial packaging photography, realistic shadows, subtle reflections, balanced white background, sharp focus, high resolution, professional industrial design board, clean alignment, generous negative space, realistic scale, luxury ecommerce proposal board, landscape composition, 16:9 ratio. 英雄包装最突出，辅助模块清晰但更小，整体像真正给客户汇报的 packaging concept board。

包装文案块：在画面中尝试渲染简短且清晰的上包装文字，避免密集长段落。
可见文字控制为少量短词：
品牌主标：麒麟西瓜
英文副标：KIRIN WATERMELON
提案标题：夏季精品礼箱
辅助语：清甜脆爽 / 产地精选 / 双果礼赠
角标占位：产地徽记 / 可变信息区 / 物流面单区 / 条码区 / 二维码区
请将所有文字视为短标签式排版，保持高级感和留白，不要生成大段难读文本。

最终效果要求：professional premium fruit ecommerce packaging proposal board, one oversized 45-degree hero package, photorealistic paper and corrugated texture, heavy-fruit protective insert, coherent opening structure, realistic rigid gift box plus shipping sleeve logic, production-intent dieline visualization, restrained luxury agricultural brand identity, clean technical annotations, physically plausible structure, elegant high-end Chinese packaging presentation.

title: 木漏れ日の部屋
prompt:
主題：木漏れ日の部屋

主体：
横長4:3の室内ポートレート。画面右側に20代女性が座り、上半身から脚先まで入る全身寄りの構図。人物は画面全体の約半分を占め、脚を左前方へ伸ばして斜めのラインを作る。左側には本棚とレコードラック、右側には水槽と木製テーブルを配置し、窓辺の小さな日系アトリエのような空間にする。

人物・表情：
明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨、膝に柔らかなハイライトが入り、自然な肌理を残す。精密で上品なドールライク日系メイク。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳には小さく澄んだキャッチライト。顔は左上へ軽く向け、窓辺の光を見上げるような静かな表情。

服装・ポーズ：

prompt:
Create a realistic 3:4 vertical environmental portrait with the feeling of an intimate everyday snapshot. An adult woman around 20 to 26 years old is lying on her stomach across a bed layered with rumpled sheets, a red-and-green plaid covering and several brown and charcoal pillows. Both elbows press into the pillows to support her upper body. Her hands meet naturally beneath her chin, fingers overlapping with small irregularities as she holds a plain transparent cylindrical glass containing a little water or a pale drink. Her head is lifted and turned gently toward frame left, while her eyes look past the camera toward the upper-left corner as though she is quietly listening to someone nearby. Her lips are naturally closed or only barely parted. The expression is soft, alert, thoughtful and slightly absent-minded, without direct eye contact or an obvious smile.

Her body extends diagonally toward the upper-right side of the frame. Both knees are bent and her socked feet lift behind her at unequal heights and slightly different angles, preserving the relaxed asymmetry of a real resting pose. She has a small oval face, a soft jawline, large clear eyes, a refined short nose and naturally full lips. Use a restrained doll-inspired makeup direction commonly found in East Asian fashion editorials: a thin fair-toned base with subtle natural texture, muted pink color through the cheeks and central face, narrow brown-black eyeliner, naturally lengthened lashes, softly defined lower-eye fullness, straight relaxed brows and glossy coral-pink or peach-pink lips. Preserve the original facial proportions and avoid a generic influencer face, celebrity replacement or exaggerated youthful appearance.

Her hair is long, deep chocolate brown and nearly black in shadow, styled in broad loose waves with a fragmented straight fringe across the forehead. Keep believable volume at the crown, a few irregular strands and areas compressed against the pillows and body. Direct sunlight should reveal warm chestnut and reddish-brown highlights without making the hair look uniformly curled or wig-like.

She wears an oversized deep-navy vintage Fair Isle knit top with cream, blue-gray, brick-red and pale-purple snowflake, diamond and zigzag motifs. The material is thick, soft and faintly fuzzy, with loose cuffs, a dropped shoulder line and natural compression folds around the elbows. The lower garment is a warm cream openwork crochet mini skirt or skort with handmade floral openings, a scalloped edge and a small dark tie detail, paired with ivory-white ribbed mid-calf socks featuring ruffled cuffs and relaxed wear creases. The visible skin is limited to the face, a small area of the neck, both hands, fingers and wrists, and a small section of leg between the garment and the socks. Keep the shoulders, chest, waist, abdomen, back, hips and buttocks covered. Her skin is fair with a neutral peach undertone and faint natural pinkness in the cheeks and fingertips. It should appear soft, finely textured and lightly hydrated, with the tactile quality of warm smooth satin while retaining tiny realistic details around the knuckles, palms, nose and facial planes.

title: A realistic vertical smartphone travel p
prompt:
A realistic vertical smartphone travel photo in a 9:16 aspect ratio. An adult young woman stands on a tropical or subtropical forest path, surrounded by dense green plants, tree trunks, vines, fallen leaves, and a shadowed walkway broken by sunlight. She leans slightly toward the camera, her head shifted a little to the right, with one hand raised near her forehead in a relaxed two-finger gesture, as if she had just paused under the trees for a spontaneous photo. She looks naturally into the lens with clear relaxed eyes, a closed-lip soft smile, gentle cheeks, and a subtle dimple. The expression should feel intimate, confident, and unforced.

Preserve a soft oval face, natural eye shape, delicate nose bridge, full cheeks, clean skin, and slight smartphone beauty-filter softness. The makeup should follow an East Asian social-media / K-beauty travel aesthetic: translucent base, soft peach-pink blush, natural eyeliner, subtle under-eye softness, and rosy pink lips, without heavy contouring. Her hair is medium-long straight chestnut brown with a muted burgundy-purple undertone, lightly parted bangs, and ends falling over the shoulders and upper chest. It should have a slightly humid summer texture, a little naturally messy, with tiny leaf-filtered highlights on the crown. Black sunglasses rest on top of her head, and a black side bag with a pale printed shoulder strap appears along one side.

She wears a deep gray, slightly blue-purple, low-scoop sleeveless fitted mini dress or sporty one-piece. It has wide straps, a low rounded neckline, soft elastic fabric, natural tension curves around the chest, and horizontal wrinkles around the waist and abdomen from her leaning pose. The skirt has a side-tie or wrap-like detail. Visible skin includes the face, neck, collarbones, shoulders, both arms, underarm-adjacent area, upper chest/decolletage, and part of the upper thighs below the skirt hem. The waist, hips, back, and buttocks are mostly covered and should not be additionally exposed. Her skin tone is light warm with a peach-pink and pale golden outdoor cast. The skin should look smooth and soft to the touch, slightly warm from humid air, with a mild natural sheen on the shoulders, arms, collarbones, and upper chest, not plastic or over-smoothed.

The photo should feel like a close-range casual smartphone shot, around 24-28mm equivalent wide angle. Keep a mild wide-angle perspective so the raised arm and upper body feel closer to the viewer. The framing is a tight half-body to upper-thigh crop, with natural cropping of the raised arm, bag, and side edges, slightly shifted to the right rather than perfectly centered. Lighting is natural midday forest light: strong sun is broken by the tree canopy, creating irregular dappled highlights on the edge of the face, arms, collarbones, upper chest, and ground. Green foliage adds a faint cool bounce light, while shadows stay deep green and brown-black. Keep smartphone-photo imperfections such as local softness, slight motion blur, compression noise in the leaves, and a real unpolished travel-photo feeling. She had just lifted her hand against the sunlight, she is looking at the camera now, and she may laugh and keep walking in the next second.

Avoid: underage appearance, excessive nudity, explicit sexualization, exaggerated body proportions, plastic skin, studio lighting, perfectly symmetrical commercial composition, anime style, CGI look, mirror selfie, distorted fingers, and overly blurred background.

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライトが入り、過度な美肌補正ではなく自然な肌理を残す。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さく澄んだキャッチライト。視線は画面右上の窓外へ向け、唇は少しだけ開き、眠気が残るような静かな表情。髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン。薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下までのミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、ふんわりした空気感と自然な束感がある。細いハイライト、柔らかなツヤ、少量の自然な後れ毛を丁寧に描写する。

服装・ポーズ：
アイボリーのリブ素材クロップドキャミソール。胸元に小さなボタンと控えめなレース縁があり、柔らかい布地が身体に沿って自然な丸みと立体感を作る。裾はバスト下あたりで止まり、鎖骨、肩、上腹部、ウエストラインが朝光でなめらかに見える。下は同系色の居家用ショートパンツ。ウエストはゴム仕様で、中央に細い紐のリボン結び。裾に小さなフリルがあり、布地には細かな凹凸と柔らかなシワがある。アクセサリーは目立たせず、全体を清潔で日系の部屋着スタイルにまとめる。
左腕は頭上へ伸ばし、肘が画面右上に大きく入る。右腕も上げて後頭部付近に回し、首から肩、脇、腰にかけてゆるやかなS字のラインを作る。腰はわずかに画面左へ反らせ、上半身は窓側へひねる。腹部は自然に引き締まり、過度な筋肉表現ではなく柔らかく健康的な体型。

背景・光：
明るい朝の寝室。画面左に白い木枠の大きな窓と薄いシアーカーテンがあり、窓外には青空が淡く見える。後景には白い壁、木製の小さな棚、観葉植物、ぼかされたポストカード、ぬいぐるみ、ベッドリネンが配置される。文字は読めない程度にぼかす。主光源は左上の窓から入る暖かい自然光。人物の左肩、髪、頬、胸元、腹部、ショートパンツの紐に明るいハイライトが入り、右側へ柔らかな影が落ちる。カーテン越しの拡散光と直射光が混ざり、白い布や肌に淡い反射光が回る。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図、スマートフォン写真のような自然な近距離感。カメラは腰より少し低い位置から軽く見上げる。人物の顔は画面上部右寄り、ウエストとショートパンツは画面下部中央。左側の窓で縦の奥行きを作り、右奥の壁飾りとベッドは浅い被写界深度で柔らかくぼかす。焦点は顔、髪、胸元の服地、腹部の肌質、パンツのリボンに自然に合う。背景は明るく溶け、人物だけが立体的に浮かぶ。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真表現。日系ポートレート、朝の自然光、柔らかいコントラスト、透明感のある肌、布地のリブ感、細かな髪の流れ、淡いフィルムライクな粒子。色調はアイボリー、クリーム、淡いベージュ、ミルクティーブラウン、窓の薄いブルーを中心にまとめる。過度に派手な加工ではなく、雑誌の朝時間特集のような落ち着いた仕上がり。

ネガティブ：

人物位于画面中央。画面左侧是一扇带白色木框的大窗户和轻薄的白色纱帘；右后方是一张整理整齐的白色床铺、小型木质置物架、绿色观叶植物、模糊到无法辨认内容的明信片，以及一个小巧的毛绒玩具。

女性具有自然、真实的成年外貌。肤色偏明亮的象牙米色，带有淡淡的粉润血色和自然肌肤纹理。妆容包括浅玫瑰粉腮红、香槟米色与粉棕色系的自然眼妆、偏浅棕色眉毛，以及具有通透感的粉米色唇妆。她看向窗外，表情平静柔和，带有一丝清晨刚睡醒的朦胧感。

头发为明亮的奶茶灰棕色，搭配轻薄的空气感刘海和脸周层次。发长为过肩的中长发，发尾自然微微内扣，具有柔和光泽和自然散落的细碎发丝。

整体色调以象牙白、奶油色、浅米色、奶茶棕和窗外的淡蓝色为主。画面对比柔和，保留自然肤质、细致发丝、罗纹面料纹理和轻微胶片颗粒。最终效果如同日本生活方式杂志中的清晨专题，安静、温柔、清新且富有留白感。

避免出现：看起来未成年的角色、幼态面容、不自然的人体结构、多余手指、缺失手指、关节破坏、错误透视、相互矛盾的阴影、可辨认文字、品牌标志、水印、过度磨皮以及塑料质感皮肤。

title: Create a clean, uninterrupted vertical 9
prompt: Create a clean, uninterrupted vertical 9:16 original photograph with absolutely no short-video application interface. Do not include a phone status bar, time, battery indicator, signal icons, menu, profile image, follow button, like, comment, favorite, share controls, numerical counters, username, hashtags, captions, notification box, progress bar, bottom navigation, watermark, platform logo, screenshot border, or any readable text.  Photograph an unmistakably adult woman, approximately 24 to 30 years old, seated at the entrance of a tropical seaside wooden pavilion. Place her near the center of the composition. Her body turns slightly to one side, while her head and upper torso face the camera.  One leg bends high in front of her body, with the thigh and knee close to the camera and filling the central lower foreground. The shin continues diagonally toward the lower-right area. Her other leg folds beside or behind her, revealing a rounded knee and part of the thigh. Because the foreground leg is closer to the smartphone wide-angle lens, it appears subtly elongated, but the anatomy and proportions remain natural.  The hand on frame-left rises beside the ear and lightly touches the hair. Her other hand rests naturally near the knee of the folded leg. Keep her spine mostly upright without stiffness, with a slight shoulder tilt and the raised-hand shoulder sitting a little higher. The foreground leg creates a strong diagonal through the composition.  She looks directly into the lens with a warm, confident, relaxed gaze. Her mouth forms a natural tooth-revealing smile, as though the photographer had just said something that made her smile immediately before the shutter.  Preserve a softly oval face, a relatively narrow but gentle jaw, naturally full cheeks, and balanced eye, nose, and lip proportions. Avoid an extremely pointed chin, oversized eyes, an unnaturally tiny nose or mouth, or a generic over-edited influencer face.  Use a refined translucent makeup style commonly seen in East Asian summer resort portraits and fashion-oriented social imagery: a lightweight luminous base, naturally shaped dark brows, warm brown and peach eye shadow, fine black eyeliner, defined but restrained lashes, subtle apricot blush, and coral nude-pink lips. The frontal light brightens the face while delicate shadows remain around the eye sockets, nose, and jaw.  Give her shoulder-length natural black straight hair with a side part. The ends fall near the collarbones and shoulders. One side rests close to the cheek, while the other forms a gentle inward or outward curve. Keep the hair soft and generally smooth, with slight root volume, mild strand grouping caused by humid seaside air, and a few natural flyaways beside the face and behind the ear. Avoid stiff wig texture or continuous plastic-like highlights.  She wears a rich mustard-yellow, ginger-yellow, or warm golden-yellow spaghetti-strap maxi dress. The upper section has a lightly structured bustier-inspired construction, very thin straps, a gently sweetheart or softly squared low neckline, and visible curved and vertical shaping seams beneath the bust. The textile supports the chest naturally and follows the waist while retaining realistic tension, seams, and small wrinkles.  The skirt has a high side slit and dense side ruching. The seated pose opens the slit naturally, revealing large areas of the thighs, knees, and foreground shin. Long mustard-gold fabric descends along one side of the body, forming vertical folds and pooled sections near the bottom of the frame. A very small pink-and-white floral or soft decorative accent may remain near the slit edge.  Use soft matte or low-sheen draping fabric that responds naturally to gravity, sitting pressure, tension, and gathering. Preserve irregular ruching, compression marks, and folds. Do not turn the dress into sequins, metal, plastic, transparent fabric, a swimsuit, or a short dress.  Add a short white pearl necklace close to the collarbones, small silver-white stud earrings, and several narrow dark or gold circular bangles on the raised wrist. Do not place a smartphone, mirror, selfie stick, camera, or handheld prop inside the image.  Her body is slim and balanced with elongated limbs, a light shoulder and neck line, and a naturally defined waist. The chest is naturally medium-to-full and realistically supported by the structured dress. Do not create an extreme waist or exaggerated anatomy.  Visible skin includes the full face, neck, collarbones, upper chest, shoulders, arms, wrists, hands, large areas of both thighs, both knees, the foreground calf, ankle, and part of the instep. Use light warm-neutral skin that appears creamy beneath frontal light, with subtle peach-pink highlights.  Apply mild smartphone beauty smoothing while retaining fine texture and tonal variation around the knees, elbows, knuckles, and ankles. The skin should look as though it would feel warm, soft, finely textured, and lightly moisturized with a clean satin finish. Avoid wet gloss, oily skin, waxiness, plastic smoothness, or broad overexposure.  Behind her is a tropical wooden pavilion at a seaside hotel, resort, or ocean-view restaurant. Preserve a roughly symmetrical wooden doorway, diagonal support beams, railings, and lattice structures on both sides. Large deep-green palm leaves extend inward across the roof.  A small wooden decorative plaque may remain in the center background, but it should contain only an unreadable abstract white curved shape, never readable lettering or a brand logo. The distant sky is immediately after sunset, with a saturated orange-red glow near the horizon fading upward into dark brown-purple, deep blue-black, and near-black.  Most of the pavilion interior, wooden beams, and palm foliage remain in deep shadow. The foreground is rough stone, exposed aggregate, or pebbled flooring, with the mustard-yellow dress descending toward the lower edge.  Illuminate the subject with a direct smartphone flash or compact LED positioned close to the lens. The subject receives strong neutral-to-warm frontal illumination and appears significantly brighter than the background. Create bright softened highlights on the forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, collarbones, shoulder peaks, forearms, front thighs, knees, and shin. Retain deeper shadows beneath the jaw, under the hair, below the chest, along the inner arms, between the overlapping legs, and inside the dress folds.  The foreground knee and shin may appear slightly brighter because they are closest to the light, but they must retain believable skin texture and must not become featureless white areas.  Use a smartphone main camera or compact digital camera with an approximately 24 to 28 mm full-frame-equivalent lens. Position the lens in front of the woman at a relatively low height, close to knee level, and tilt slightly upward. Use moderately deep depth of field so the face, foreground leg, dress, wooden pavilion, and palm leaves remain recognizable. Slightly soften the distant sky without exaggerated portrait-mode blur.  Retain authentic low-light smartphone qualities: mild computational sharpening, restrained skin smoothing, strong contrast between the brightly illuminated subject and dark environment, slight digital noise in the shadows, a faint halo around some hair edges, fine side ruching, irregular fabric folds, and rough ground texture. Avoid flawless commercial-advertising polish, neon light, blue rim lighting, anime styling, or CGI rendering.  The orange-red afterglow had already lowered toward the horizon. title: Act as the Global Creative Director for
prompt:
Act as the Global Creative Director for Royal Enfield. Think like a collaboration between Royal Enfield Global Design, Sid Lee, AKQA, Wieden+Kennedy, Pentagram, National Geographic Adventure, Fuel Motorcycles, The Ride Magazine, and Apple Marketing. Your objective is NOT to create a motorcycle wallpaper. Your objective is to create a flagship Instagram campaign that celebrates instinct, freedom and exploration. The final artwork should feel like a frame from a premium adventure documentary rather than a motorcycle advertisement. Reject: generic bike posters, floating motorcycles, cheap CGI, artificial dust, oversaturated colours, AI-generated automotive clichés. Campaign: IN GUT WE TRUST. Platform: Instagram. Aspect Ratio: 3:4 Vertical. Resolution: 8K Ultra High Resolution. Hyper-realistic Commercial Photography. Editorial Adventure Advertising. Brand: Royal Enfield. Motorcycle: Bear 650. Category: Modern Retro Scrambler. Core Values: Freedom, Adventure, Exploration, Authenticity, Craftsmanship, Instinct, Heritage. Brand Truth: The Bear 650 isn’t built to race. It is built to explore roads that don’t appear on maps. Psychological Position: Ride because your instinct says yes. Hero Motorcycle: Royal Enfield Bear 650. Exact factory specification. Maintain original geometry. Correct suspension height. Original spoke wheels. OEM tyres. Original exhaust. Correct engine detailing. Original fuel tank graphics. Maintain exact paint finish. Recommended colour: Wild Honey OR Golden Shadow. Maintain authentic Royal Enfield craftsmanship. Location: Remote mountain trail during golden hour. Rocky terrain. Dry grass. Ancient winding road. Distant mountain ranges. Warm dusty atmosphere. No modern buildings. No traffic. No city. Only endless landscape. The environment should communicate adventure before the motorcycle does. Story: The rider has just stopped after discovering a breathtaking viewpoint. Helmet rests naturally on the handlebar. Fine dust still hangs in the air. Engine quietly ticks as it cools. The landscape is silent. The Bear 650 stands ready for the next unknown road. This is not about speed. This is about freedom. Composition: Top: Royal Enfield logo. Small and understated. Large editorial headline. IN GUT. WE TRUST. Center: Motorcycle occupies approximately 70% of the frame. Three-quarter front angle. Low camera position. Strong leading lines. Natural depth. Bottom: Minimal specification panel. 648cc Parallel Twin. 47 PS. Scrambler DNA. Ride Beyond Roads. Small CTA. Explore More →. Swiss editorial grid. Large negative space. Perfect visual hierarchy. Graphic Design: Minimal expedition-inspired graphics. Swiss Grid. Topographic contour lines. GPS coordinates. Altitude marker. Compass bearing. Subtle trail route overlay. Tiny technical annotations. Everything inspired by adventure maps. No decorative clutter. Colour System: Primary: Wild Honey Yellow, Matte Black, Warm Sand, Stone Grey. Secondary: Burnt Earth, Graphite, Steel, Warm Beige. Accent: Brushed Aluminium, Royal Enfield Red (very subtle), Dusty Olive. Lighting: Golden hour. Natural low-angle sunlight. Soft volumetric haze. Long shadows. Warm rim light. Realistic chrome reflections. Premium commercial motorcycle lighting. Natural HDR. Camera: Phase One XF IQ4 150MP. Schneider Kreuznach 80mm LS. Medium-format photography. Low eye-level perspective. Ultra-high dynamic range. True-to-life proportions. Natural depth of field. No exaggerated wide-angle distortion. Material Detail: Metallic paint texture. Brushed aluminium. Engine cooling fins. Tyre sidewall texture. Fine dust on swingarm. Natural chain finish. Leather seat grain. Brake rotor machining marks. Spoke reflections. Stone texture. Everything physically accurate. Colour Grading: Kodak Vision3 250D inspired. Warm amber highlights. Deep matte blacks. Earth-tone saturation. Soft cinematic contrast. Natural skin of the landscape. Fine analogue grain. Luxury adventure colour science.

Negative Prompt: NO racing posture. NO track environment. NO neon lighting. NO futuristic city. NO excessive mud splash. NO drifting. NO burnout. NO fake motion blur. NO oversized typography. NO AI artifacts. NO plastic textures. NO unrealistic reflections. NO clutter. Quality Bar: Royal Enfield Global Campaign. National Geographic Adventure. Apple-level composition. Behance Featured. Cannes Lions Automotive. Premium editorial storytelling. Viewer reaction: “This isn’t a motorcycle advertisement. It’s an invitation to disappear into the horizon.”

title: 影をほどく指
prompt:
主題：
影をほどく指

主体：
縦長2:3の写真。古い木造商店が並ぶ日本の路地で、若い女性が画面中央やや右に立つ。頭頂から太もも付近までを写し、人物は画面の約55％を占める。背景の暗い壁面と、右上から斜めに差し込む強い日差しを大きく見せる。

人物・表情：
明るいアイボリーベージュの肌に、自然な血色と繊細な肌理を残す。淡いローズのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイメイク、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、柔らかな明るい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのリップ。表情は静かで少し物思いに沈み、顔を正面よりわずかに画面左へ向け、視線は画面左奥を見る。瞳に小さなキャッチライトを入れる。

服装・ポーズ：
薄手の白いノースリーブブラウス。細かなピンタックと控えめなレース、柔らかいコットン素材で、肩と鎖骨が自然に見える涼しげな夏服。ボトムは淡いブルーの小花柄が入ったハイウエストの軽いフレアスカート。人物自身の右手をこめかみ付近へ上げ、指先で髪をそっと整える。右肘は外側へ曲げ、左腕は体の横へ自然に下ろす。重心は片脚にわずかに寄せ、肩の力を抜く。

背景・光：
昭和の面影が残る木造の古い商店街。色褪せた木板、剥がれた紙、古い看板、ぼかされて読めない日本語風のポスターを配置する。前景と画面左側は深い影、人物の顔、肩、胸元、右腕には右上から硬めの暖色光が当たる。光は斜めの大きな三角形を作り、人物の背後と画面左下へ濃い影が落ちる。木壁から淡い茶色の反射光が肌へ返る。

構図・カメラ：
胸より少し低い位置からのほぼ平視。50mm相当、人物との距離は約2.5メートル。人物を中央より少し右へ置き、上部と左側に広い暗部を残す。右上の明るい壁と左側の黒い影を対角線で分ける。顔と右手に正確にピントを合わせ、背景は軽くぼかしながら木材や紙の質感は判別できる程度に残す。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな日本のファッションポートレート。自然な肌、一本ずつ見える髪、ミルクティーアッシュブラウンの細いハイライト、薄いシースルーバング、顔まわりのレイヤー、肩下までのミディアムロング。毛先は内側へゆるくカールし、少量の後れ毛が光を受ける。低彩度のブラウン、アイボリー、淡いブルーを基調に、柔らかなフィルム粒子と深い黒を残す。

ネガティブ：
不自然な顔、不自然な視線、余分な指、欠けた指、手首や肘の破綻、髪と指の融合、衣服の透けすぎ、浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、読める文字、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

title: Create an ultra-premium single-image adv
prompt:
Create an ultra-premium single-image advertising poster for Almond Croissant, designed as a dreamy pink cosmic bakery campaign with strong hero-product dominance, extreme food realism, and a refined whimsical fantasy atmosphere. The composition must feel cinematic, adorable, luxurious, and globally premium, with one monumental almond croissant floating in the upper center of the image, a giant pink planet filling the background, and a miniature fantasy bakery world unfolding across the lower ground. The final image should feel like a world-class commercial pastry key visual, balancing irresistible realism with soft surreal storytelling.

Core concept:
 The campaign should present the almond croissant not simply as a pastry, but as a glowing celestial arrival, as if a perfect bakery creation has entered a sugar-colored atmosphere like a comet. The croissant remains fully realistic, delicious, tactile, and premium, while the surrounding world transforms into a soft pink dreamscape of sugar dust, floating pastry fragments, planetary haze, and miniature bakery narrative. The image must preserve absolute product leadership while allowing the fantasy environment to amplify scale, sweetness, and emotional wonder.

Single-poster structure:

title: A realistic vertical 9:16 phone selfie,
prompt:
A realistic vertical 9:16 phone selfie, shot from an extremely close high angle, with the camera held above and slightly in front of the subject. The subject is an adult woman with a cool porcelain-pale complexion. Her face fills the upper half of the image, with delicate doll-like proportions: a small face, pointed chin, large clear round eyes, a narrow nose bridge, soft nose tip, and full muted rosy lips. She looks upward directly into the lens, her gaze quiet, bright, slightly innocent, and emotionally restrained, as if she had just lifted her head when the shutter was pressed.

She has long creamy platinum-blonde hair with slightly darker roots. The hair is mostly straight with natural soft bends, airy volume, and imperfect looseness. Many strands fall across her forehead and face; several thin strands sweep horizontally over her eyes, nose bridge, and lips, creating real foreground obstruction. The flash catches the hair in thin silky highlights. The hair should feel smooth and soft, but not overly neat.

Her makeup follows an East Asian fashion / sweet-cool girl-group beauty direction: soft light-brown brows, thin lifted eyeliner, separated long lashes, subtle under-eye aegyo-sal, faint pink tones under the eyes, gentle highlight on the nose bridge and tip, barely-there blush, and muted rose-beige or soft pink gradient lips. Do not turn the face into mature Western glam, and avoid excessive retouching.

She wears a simple fitted black bare-shoulder bandeau or thin-strap low-cut top. The black fabric contrasts strongly with her cool pale skin. Visible skin includes the face, neck, collarbones, shoulders, upper chest, upper arms, forearm, hands, and parts of the thighs and knees near the bottom of the frame. The waist is mostly hidden by the high angle, hair, and clothing; the back, buttocks, and hips are basically not visible. The skin should look delicate, soft, and slightly powdery like thin velvet, suggesting a cool smooth touch while keeping real subtle skin transitions around the neck, shoulders, and collarbones. The lower body shows white lace thigh-high stockings with clear lace bands and floral texture, plus black pointed glossy shoes near the bottom.

Her pose is seated or half-seated indoors. One arm reaches toward the camera for the selfie, entering the edge of the frame, while the other hand gathers her long hair. Her fingers show long decorative nails in pale pink, translucent glitter, or rhinestone style. The composition should feel slightly tilted and compressed by a wide-angle phone lens, preserving the real selfie evidence: arm in frame, messy hair obstruction, close-distance distortion, and imperfect framing.

Lighting comes from a close phone flash near the lens, directly illuminating the face, shoulders, collarbones, and upper chest. It creates cool white highlights, low shadows, slight overexposure, and a bright-front / dark-back contrast. The background falls into dim indoor ambient light. The setting is a nighttime lounge, café, or private booth-like space, with dark leather seating, a white marble round table, a black phone on the table, gray-white marble flooring, and small gold metallic decorative details. Keep the social-media snapshot texture: slight sharpening, dark-area noise, flash reflection, local overexposure, and casual uneven lighting rather than a polished studio look.

The mood is cool, refined, sweet-cool, intimate, and nocturnal, like a brief gaze left after something had already happened that night. Preserve the emotional residue, the close private distance, and the accidental realism. Avoid watermarks, platform logos, plastic skin, perfect symmetry, studio lighting, cartoon or anime style, exaggerated body curves, distorted hands, extra fingers, and an overly bright background.

title: 逆光にほどける笑顔
prompt:
主題：
逆光にほどける笑顔

主体：
強い木漏れ日の中で、白い細肩紐ワンピースの若い女性が振り向いて微笑む近接ポートレート。人物の顔と上半身を画面中央から右へ大きく置き、左側の白い逆光、金色に透ける長い髪、緑の玉ボケを重ねる。

人物・表情：
やや面長の卵形の顔と小さく丸い顎を持ち、顔を正面へ向ける。大きな茶色のアーモンド形の瞳、細く緩いアーチ眉、細い鼻筋と小さな鼻先、淡いコーラル色の艶唇で歯を見せた柔らかな笑顔。明るい肌に薄いピンクの頬と控えめな目元メイク。胸下までの栗色の髪は薄い前髪と顔周りの毛束を持ち、風で画面右へ流れる。

服装・ポーズ：
白い細肩紐のワンピース。胸元は深い曲線のネックラインで、薄い花柄の織り模様と胸下の細い切替が見える。上半身を前へ傾けながら画面左へひねり、右肩を手前へ上げて顔だけをカメラへ戻す。

背景・光：
背景全体は黄緑の葉と円形の大きな玉ボケで、画面左は白く飛ぶほど明るい日差し、右上には濃い緑が残る。画面左後方からの暖かく柔らかな逆光が髪と肩を金色に縁取り、レンズフレアと淡い霞を作る。

構図・カメラ：
縦3:4。カメラは肩と同じ高さの水平視点で、頭頂から胸下までを収めるクローズアップ。顔を上半分の中央へ大きく置き、後頭部と髪を右端、胸元を下端で裁切し、左半分に明るい光の余白を残す。両目にピントを合わせ、背景は大きくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
白、金色、黄緑を基調とした高精細フォトリアル写真。自然な肌理、艶唇、透ける毛束、薄い白布、柔らかな逆光と円形ボケを写実的に描く。

ネガティブ：
顔立ちの大幅変更；左側の強い逆光を弱めない

title: 草原を渡る風
prompt:
主題：
草原を渡る風

主体：
背の高い緑の草原に立つ20代女性の縦構図ポートレート。白い夏のワンピース姿で、片腕を斜め下へ伸ばし、指先で草に触れながら遠くを見つめている。髪、袖、周囲の草が同じ風を受けて自然に揺れる瞬間。

人物・表情：
顔を画面左へ軽く向け、視線も左奥へ外す。柔らかな卵型の顔、すっきりした下顎、横長で自然な二重の目、細めの淡いブラウン眉、滑らかな鼻筋、淡いコーラルピンクの唇。ベージュピンクの薄いアイメイク、自然な睫毛、控えめな頬の血色、軽い肌の艶。明るいブラウンのミディアムロングヘア、薄い前髪と顔まわりのレイヤー、毛先と細い髪束が風で画面右へ流れる。

服装・ポーズ：
柔らかな白いコットン素材のロングワンピース。細い肩紐、細かなギャザーの入った広めのラウンドネック、肩からやや落ちる透け感のあるゆったりした半袖、絞られたウエスト、軽く広がるスカート。上半身をわずかにひねり、片腕を自然に下ろして手のひらを開き、指先だけを草先に触れさせる。肩と首の力を抜いた穏やかな立ち姿。

背景・光：
見渡す限り続く濃淡のある緑の草原。手前の長い草が人物の腕やスカート下部に重なり、奥の丘と淡い曇り空は大きくぼかす。柔らかな自然光が正面斜めから均一に回り、強い影を作らない。白と落ち着いた緑を中心にした低彩度の夏色。

構図・カメラ：
縦3:4。人物を画面中央やや右に大きく配置したミディアムロングショットで、頭上には少量の余白を残す。目線に近い自然な高さから撮影し、顔と上半身に焦点を合わせる。前景の草を大きく入れ、背景は浅い被写界深度で滑らかにぼかす。人物の視線方向である画面左側に穏やかな空間を残す。

質感・スタイル：
自然光によるファッションポートレート写真。肌、髪、薄い白布、草の細い葉を繊細かつ現実的に描写する。柔らかな階調、穏やかなコントラスト、控えめな色補正。過度な美肌加工や強いHDRを避けた、清涼感のある写真表現。

ネガティブ：
指や手の形の崩れ；肩紐と透け感のある袖を省略しない；髪と草の風向きを左右反転しない

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical aspect ratio. A wide-angle shot from a very low angle near the ground, capturing the full body from the top of the head to both skates. Focus is sharp on the shoes and the person, while the background park lights are lightly blurred.

A high-definition photorealistic night scene featuring a palette of black, white, dusty pink, and warm streetlight white. Precisely renders leather textures, laces, resin wheels, ribbed socks, paving stones, and harsh night lighting.

title: 逆光へ掲げる白花
prompt:
主題：
逆光へ掲げる白花

主体：
暗い石造りのような室内で、白い薄布のベアトップを着た若い女性が、小さな白花の束を左上へ掲げる腰上ポートレート。人物を強い仰角で見上げ、画面左上前景の手と花、頭後ろの強い逆光、下部の明るいアーチ窓を見せる。

人物・表情：
小さな卵形の顔を画面左上へ向け、顎を大きく上げて淡い茶色の瞳で花を見る。細い眉、小さな鼻、淡い珊瑚色の唇を少し開いた静かな横顔。肩下までの明るい茶髪は薄い前髪を作り、逆光で金色に縁取られた細い毛束が画面右へ浮く。

服装・ポーズ：
白い半透明のストラップレス短丈トップ。胸上を細かなゴムギャザーで留め、非常に薄い布を二重に重ねて大きな波形フリルとして胸下へ広げる。下部に同色のギャザーウエストが少量見える。人物自身の右腕を画面左上へ伸ばし、細い茎の白い小花束を指先で持つ。反対の腕は身体の後ろへ隠し、上半身をわずかに反らす。

背景・光：
背景は黒灰色の高い壁と柱で、画面下部に白く輝く細長いアーチ窓が二つ並ぶ。頭頂の真後ろから硬い白い逆光が差し、髪、肩、薄布、花を明るく縁取る。空中には多数の細かな塵と数個の透明な泡が光を受けて浮かぶ。

構図・カメラ：
縦3:4。カメラを腰より低く置く非常に強い仰角で、左上の花束から腰途中までを収める腰上像。人物を画面高のほぼ全体へ大きく写し、手と花を左上の前景、顔を上三分の一、白いフリルを中央、腹部を下半分へ置く。顔と花にピントを合わせ、暗い壁は柔らかくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
深い黒灰色、白、暖かな肌色、逆光の金色を基調にした高精細フォトリアル写真。透ける皺布、髪の縁光、白い花、空中の塵と泡、強い明暗差を繊細に描く。

ネガティブ：
左上へ掲げる白花と強い仰角を弱めない；頭後ろの逆光を正面光にしない

上体を少し画面左へ傾け、顔はほぼ正面、茶色の瞳でカメラを静かに見つめる。丸みのある卵形と小さな顎、横幅のあるアーモンド形の目、細い平行眉、華奢な鼻筋と小さな鼻先、薄めの上唇と柔らかい下唇。明るい肌に淡いピンクの頬と控えめなアイメイク。茶髪は薄い前髪を下ろし、低いサイド寄りのまとめ髪に白いレースリボン、濡れた細い後れ毛が頬と首に沿う。

細い肩紐、縁のレース、中央の結び目が見える白い三角ビキニ水着。前を開けた淡いブルーのデニムショートパンツと小さなペンダント。砂に座って人物自身の左腕を下へ伸ばして支え、人物自身の右腕（画面右側）を曲げ、平らな手のひらを眉上に水平にかざす。

高キーのフォトリアル実写写真。柔らかな肌、白いレース、デニム、砂と波の質感を清潔感のある淡い色調で高精細に表現する。

ネガティブ：
額にかざす右手の省略；水着の中央結びを消さない

3:4の縦長、真上から垂直に見下ろす俯瞰視点で頭から交差した脚までを画面内に収めた全身寄りのファッションポートレート。顔は左上寄り、露出した右腿は右下、広いドレープが周囲の余白を埋める。顔と花飾りにピントを置き、布全体も深い被写界深度で明瞭に見せる。

上質なフォトリアル実写写真。半透明シフォン、微細なプリーツ、立体的な花飾り、肌、髪を高精細に描き、珊瑚色からモーヴの同系色でまとめる。

ネガティブ：
真上の俯瞰を正面立ち姿にしない；広いドレープと深いスリットを省略しない

title: 朝光の余白
prompt:
主題：
朝光の余白

主体：
縦長9:16の室内ポートレート。画面中央に20代の自然で現実感のある女性が大きく写り、上半身から太もも上までを低い位置から見上げる構図。人物は画面の約8割を占め、左側に大きな窓、右奥にベッドと小さな壁飾りが入る。白とアイボリーを基調にした、やわらかな朝の空気が漂う一枚。

人物・表情：
20代女性。明るいアイボリーベージュ寄りの白肌で、ほんのりピンクの血色を含んだなめらかな肌質。頬、鼻先、肩、鎖骨に柔らかなハイライトが入り、過度な美肌補正ではなく自然な肌理を残す。淡いローズピンクのチーク、シャンパンベージュとピンクブラウンのアイシャドウ、細く長いまつ毛、自然な涙袋、明るめブラウンの柔らかい眉、透け感のあるピンクベージュのグロスリップ。瞳に小さく澄んだキャッチライト。視線は画面右上の窓外へ向け、唇は少しだけ開き、眠気が残るような静かな表情。髪は明るいミルクティーアッシュブラウン。薄めのシースルーバング、顔まわりに沿うレイヤーカット、肩下までのミディアムロング。毛先は内側にゆるくカールし、ふんわりした空気感と自然な束感がある。細いハイライト、柔らかなツヤ、少量の自然な後れ毛を丁寧に描写する。

服装・ポーズ：
アイボリーのリブ素材クロップドキャミソール。胸元に小さなボタンと控えめなレース縁があり、柔らかい布地が身体に沿って自然な丸みと立体感を作る。裾はバスト下あたりで止まり、鎖骨、肩、上腹部、ウエストラインが朝光でなめらかに見える。下は同系色の居家用ショートパンツ。ウエストはゴム仕様で、中央に細い紐のリボン結び。裾に小さなフリルがあり、布地には細かな凹凸と柔らかなシワがある。アクセサリーは目立たせず、全体を清潔で日系の部屋着スタイルにまとめる。
左腕は頭上へ伸ばし、肘が画面右上に大きく入る。右腕も上げて後頭部付近に回し、首から肩、脇、腰にかけてゆるやかなS字のラインを作る。腰はわずかに画面左へ反らせ、上半身は窓側へひねる。腹部は自然に引き締まり、過度な筋肉表現ではなく柔らかく健康的な体型。

背景・光：
明るい朝の寝室。画面左に白い木枠の大きな窓と薄いシアーカーテンがあり、窓外には青空が淡く見える。後景には白い壁、木製の小さな棚、観葉植物、ぼかされたポストカード、ぬいぐるみ、ベッドリネンが配置される。文字は読めない程度にぼかす。主光源は左上の窓から入る暖かい自然光。人物の左肩、髪、頬、胸元、腹部、ショートパンツの紐に明るいハイライトが入り、右側へ柔らかな影が落ちる。カーテン越しの拡散光と直射光が混ざり、白い布や肌に淡い反射光が回る。

構図・カメラ：
縦構図、スマートフォン写真のような自然な近距離感。カメラは腰より少し低い位置から軽く見上げる。人物の顔は画面上部右寄り、ウエストとショートパンツは画面下部中央。左側の窓で縦の奥行きを作り、右奥の壁飾りとベッドは浅い被写界深度で柔らかくぼかす。焦点は顔、髪、胸元の服地、腹部の肌質、パンツのリボンに自然に合う。背景は明るく溶け、人物だけが立体的に浮かぶ。

質感・スタイル：
リアルな写真表現。日系ポートレート、朝の自然光、柔らかいコントラスト、透明感のある肌、布地のリブ感、細かな髪の流れ、淡いフィルムライクな粒子。色調はアイボリー、クリーム、淡いベージュ、ミルクティーブラウン、窓の薄いブルーを中心にまとめる。過度に派手な加工ではなく、雑誌の朝時間特集のような落ち着いた仕上がり。

ネガティブ：
未成年に見える人物、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、過度な性的表現、露骨な裸、下着だけの表現、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、関節の破綻、脇や首の不自然な変形、衣服と身体の接触不良、布の浮遊、不自然な重力、誤った遠近法、光源と矛盾する影、文字化け、ロゴ、透かし、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌。

title: Goal: Create a dense editorial cultural-
prompt:
Goal: Create a dense editorial cultural-exhibition poster about Dunhuang Rhythms, combining Dunhuang mural fragments, music-and-dance archive typography, and layered museum ephemera.

Canvas: Tall vertical poster, approximately 2:3 ratio, aged warm beige rice-paper background with visible grain, stains, torn edges, faded ink, and pasted-collage seams. Overall mood is scholarly, archaeological, and highly designed, with intentional clutter but a strong grid.

Layout: Use an asymmetric high-density collage. On the far left, place four enormous stacked black Chinese calligraphy characters reading 「壁上乐舞」, occupying nearly the full height, distressed and ink-textured. Beside the large characters, add a narrow vertical Chinese subtitle reading 「敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明」. At the top center-left, add a small bilingual series label: 「丝路映像 系列展」 with “Silk Road Imaging Series” underneath. At the top right, place the main English title in elegant serif capitals: “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, with the smaller subtitle “Fragments of Murals and Music” below.

Main imagery: Use exactly 6 visible mural/image fragments, all in faded Dunhuang cave-painting colors of turquoise, cinnabar red, ochre, black, and parchment beige: 1) a large upper-right flying apsara musician fragment with flowing ribbons crossing diagonally; 2) a lower-left torn fragment showing three mural musicians or dancers; 3) a mid-right small rectangular fragment of a standing dancer; 4) a mid-lower ornate floral scroll pattern fragment; 5) a large bottom-right close-up of a female bodhisattva or apsara face with jewelry and flowing ribbons; 6) a right-edge partial vertical mural strip cropped off the page. Make the fragments look like scanned ancient wall paintings with cracks, missing plaster, chipped edges, and uneven opacity.

Information blocks: Add many thin vertical Chinese text columns like museum notes and archival captions around the collage, especially along the far left margin, middle columns, and lower center. Include exactly 4 primary info panels: 1) a right-side date and venue panel with “2026 09.05 SAT / 2027 01.16 SUN”, Chinese venue text, and “Hexi Culture Center Shanghai”; 2) a lower-left educational panel listing “Instruments” and “Dance Poses” with a small line drawing of an instrument; 3) a bottom-left organizer/credits panel with Host, Co-operation, and Visual Design lines; 4) a lower-right cave caption panel reading “Cave 285, South Wall Music and Dance Scene (detail)” with Chinese above it.

Typography and style: Mix oversized rough black Chinese brush type, refined Western serif uppercase, small Chinese Song/Ming-style vertical text, and tiny English museum captions. Use black, dark brown, muted red stamp ink, and occasional faded grid marks. Add small red seal stamps, thin archival diagrams, faint measurement lines, and marginal annotations. The design should feel like a contemporary museum poster, editorial magazine spread, and historical archive board fused together.

Constraints: Preserve a clear exhibition-poster hierarchy despite the dense collage. Do not make it modern glossy; keep everything matte, aged, weathered, and printed on textured paper. Use no photorealistic people outside the mural fragments, no 3D effects, no bright neon colors, and no empty clean white background. The most prominent readable texts should be 「壁上乐舞」, 敦煌壁画中的乐舞与文明, “DUNHUANG RHYTHMS”, and the date range 2026 09.05 / 2027 01.16.

title: Subject:
prompt:
Subject:
A white dream sitting in a pearl shell

Subject Body:
A fantastical photorealistic work where a woman in her 20s in a white lace dress sits with bent knees inside a giant open pearl shell floating on a blue sea. A giant iridescent shell fan-shapes behind the figure, and a large milky white pearl about the size of the person's torso is placed in the right lower foreground.

Character/Expression:
Small oval face and rounded jaw, horizontally long dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, clean nose bridge, and pale coral slightly parted lips. A clean-cut profile facing the top right of the screen, with a quiet gaze looking into the distance. Thin eyeliner and modest glossy skin. Dark brown hair loosely tied low at the back, with long bangs parted near the center and thin wisps around the neck.

Clothing/Pose:
Ivory white sheer lace mini dress with thin shoulder straps, deep V-neck lace trim, long wide chiffon sleeves falling from both shoulders, a thin ribbon at the center under the chest, and multilayered ruffled hem. Sitting with both knees together on the bottom side of the giant shell, dropping the waist to the heels. Place the person's own left hand on the inside of the shell on the left of the screen, and lower the right arm to the side of the body under the shadow of the sleeve. Extend the upper body and turn only the neck and face to the right of the screen.

Background/Light:
The giant bivalve shell is milky white, with deep vertical ridges and pale pink, blue, and gold iridescent reflections of the nacre layer. On the lower shell, white thin cloth and lace spread like waves, with a smooth giant pearl in the right foreground. Blue sea and horizon through the gap in the shell, with a pale blue sky above. Soft rays of light shine from the sun in the top left, brightly bordering the shell, hair, shoulders, sheer sleeves, and pearl.

Composition/Camera:
Vertical 9:16. A full-body fantasy portrait captured at a slight upward angle from a camera slightly lower than the front of the shell. Position the person near the bottom center, the upper shell of the giant shell fan-shaped across the top half, and the pearl large in the right lower foreground. Crop the wavy edge of the lower shell at the bottom edge. Broad focus on the person, pearl, and shell, with the sea becoming lightly soft (medium depth of field).

Texture/Style:
High-definition photorealistic fantasy visual merging live-action photography and high-quality CG. Precisely depict the iridescent luster of the nacre layer, smooth pearls, sheer lace and chiffon, skin, and reflections on the sea surface, summarizing in milky white and sky blue.

Negative:
Reduction of the giant open shell and the pearl in the right foreground

title: 濡れ髪に朝光
prompt:
主題：
濡れ髪に朝光

主体：
白いルームウェア姿の成人女性が、明るい窓辺のラグに座っている縦長ポートレート。人物は画面中央からやや右に大きく配置し、頭頂から太ももまでを写す。上半身が画面の約3分の2を占め、左側には窓と柔らかな背景の余白を残す。

人物・表情：
自然な黒髪のセミロング。入浴後のように少し湿った細い毛束が頬や首筋に沿い、薄い前髪が額にかかっている。頭を画面左上へわずかに傾け、窓の外へ静かに視線を向ける。力の抜けた瞳、わずかに開いた唇、眠気が残る穏やかな表情。淡いベージュとピンクを中心にした控えめなメイクで、毛穴や産毛を残した自然な肌。

服装・ポーズ：
細い肩紐と繊細なレースをあしらった白いキャミソールと、同素材 of ショートパンツ。胸元には小さなボタンと柔らかなギャザーを入れ、薄手の布が自然な重力に沿って落ちる。生成り色のざっくり編みカーディガンを肩から落とし、両腕の肘から前腕にゆるく掛ける。身体は画面左へ少しひねり、片脚を手前に曲げて座り、肩の高さをわずかにずらした自然な姿勢。

背景・光：
左側に大きな窓。窓の外には朝日を浴びた緑の葉が柔らかな玉ぼけとなって広がる。窓辺の木製テーブルに白いカップ、小さなガラス花器、細い枝を控えめに置く。主光は画面左上の窓から差し込む暖かな自然光。頬、鼻筋、鎖骨、肩、腕、太ももに柔らかなハイライトを作り、髪の右側と室内奥は穏やかな陰影に沈める。白い布と床から淡い反射光が返る。

構図・カメラ：
縦2:3。やや高い位置から見下ろす近距離撮影。人物の顔を上部中央、胸元を中央、曲げた脚を左下に置く三角形構図。窓側の余白で視線の方向を強調し、背景は大きくぼかす。50mm相当、開放寄りの浅い被写界深度。瞳と顔に焦点を合わせ、前景の脚と背景の窓辺は柔らかくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
自然光だけで撮影したフォトリアルな室内ポートレート。明るいアイボリーと淡い木目を基調に、肌の血色と窓外の緑を控えめな差し色にする。過度に滑らかにせず、肌理、細い産毛、湿った髪の束感、レースとニットの繊維を精密に描写。低コントラストで、上品なフィルム写真のような柔らかな階調。

ネガティブ：
未成年に見える人物、不自然な顔、不自然な視線、左右非対称な瞳、余分な指、欠けた指、手足の融合、肩や関節の破綻、衣服の食い込み、布地の不自然な透過、重力に反する髪や衣服、光源と矛盾する影、過度な美肌補正、プラスチックのような肌、文字、ロゴ、透かし。

title: Subject:
prompt:
Subject:
Morning gaze through glasses

Main Subject:
A woman in her 20s wearing glasses standing with her feet together in a room with a bright wooden floor, looking up at the camera overhead. The full body from head to bare feet is framed in the center of the screen, highlighting an off-white ribbed camisole and matching shorts and a strong high-angle perspective effect.

Person & Expression:
A rounded, oval small face, large dark brown eyes, well-formed natural eyebrows, a small nose, and plump pale pink lips. Facing straight up, she stares directly into the camera through thick dark brown Boston-style glasses, with her lips slightly open in an honest and quiet expression. Dark brown long hair down below her chest, thin bangs close to a center part, and soft strands of hair flowing to her shoulders.

Clothing & Pose:
A cropped camisole top with fine vertical ribs in off-white. Clearly defines the thin shoulder straps, thin wavy lace surrounding the chest, and a small center ribbon. Matching low-rise shorts come with a thin border and a white knot tie at the front center. Standing straight, barefoot with both feet and knees together, arms resting straight down by the side of her body, hands against the sides of her thighs.

Background & Lighting:
A light beige sofa and cushion to the left of the screen, a wooden low table, and a magazine on top of it. An open door with a wooden frame and a dark hallway in the back center, and a water heater remote control and switches on the white wall on the right side of the screen. Bright wood-grained floor and a gray rug. Soft natural light enters from the window direction at the top left of the screen, illuminating her face and chest uniformly, casting gentle shadows at her feet and down the hallway.

Composition & Camera:
Vertical 3:4 ratio. A full-body shot captured with an ultra-high angle wide-angle camera pointed almost straight down from above the person's head. The head and glasses are large in the upper-center of the screen, while the body down to the feet appears slender and small due to the perspective. The top of the head, shoulders, waist, and both feet are contained within the frame, with the toes placed near the lower edge. Focused sharply on both eyes and glasses, with a moderate depth of field that keeps the interior background lightly blurred.

Texture & Style:
A photorealistic real-life photo shot with natural light. High-definition rendering of skin texture and modest sheen, subtle reflections on the eyeglass lenses, the flow of each individual strand of hair, details of the ribbed fabric and lace, and the grain of the wooden floor. A quiet morning color tone based on off-white, light wood tones, and light gray.

title: 木枠鏡の振り向き自撮り
prompt:
主題：
木枠鏡の振り向き自撮り

主体：
床置きの大きな木枠鏡へ背中を向け、黒いスマートフォンで振り向き自撮りをする20代女性。画面中央右の鏡像を主役にし、左前景には同じ人物の肩と髪を大きく虚焦点で重ねる。

人物・表情：
鏡の中では細い卵形の顔と小さな顎、横長の濃茶の瞳、細い眉、小ぶりな鼻、淡い桃色の唇。左肩越しに顔を鏡へ向け、鏡像のカメラ方向を見つめて口元をわずかに緩めた穏やかな表情。胸下までの黒に近い長い髪、中央寄りの分け目、背中へ流れる緩いウェーブ。

服装・ポーズ：
くすんだ青灰色の細肩紐リブキャミソールトップと、淡い灰色の短いラップスカート。トップは背中を直線的に覆い、スカートは細かな模様、画面右腰の結び目、長く垂れる帯、揺れる短い裾を備える。身体を鏡へ背中向きに立たせて腰を画面左へひねる。人物自身の右肘を曲げ、右手で黒い三眼カメラのスマートフォンを顔横に持つ。

背景・光：
鏡の中は白い壁、濃茶のドア、木床、生成りのラグ、右奥の細い木机と小さな植物。大きな鏡は明るい木枠で画面右と上を囲む。画面左の窓から柔らかな自然光を入れ、鏡像の顔、肩、背中、脚を暖かく照らす。

構図・カメラ：
縦3:4。撮影カメラを少し傾けた全身寄りの斜め構図。木枠鏡を画面中央から右へ大きく置き、鏡像は頭頂から膝下まで収める。左前景の実体の髪と肩を画面幅の約三分の一に大きくぼかし、鏡像の顔とスマートフォンにピントを合わせる浅い被写界深度。

質感・スタイル：
室内自然光で撮影したフォトリアルな実写写真。鏡の反射、木枠、リブ布、ラップスカートの皺、髪、スマートフォンの黒い面を精細に描く。

ネガティブ：
左前景の虚焦点人物を省略しない；鏡像と実体の重複崩れ

高精細なフォトリアル実写写真。細リブ布、短い髪、木枠、薄いカーテン、花と葉を自然な朝光で柔らかく描く。淡い水色、生成り、緑を中心とした明るく穏やかなコテージ風の色調。

title: 畳で朝のストレッチ

畳で朝のストレッチ

障子から朝日が入る明るい和室の畳に座り、両脚を高く持ち上げてストレッチする一人の若い成人女性。人物を画面中央へ大きく置き、正面の顔、折り曲げた両脚、上部左へ揃えた足裏、脚を支える手を主役にする。

人物・表情：
小さな卵形の顔、明るくなめらかな肌、ダークブラウンの大きな瞳、細い自然な眉、小ぶりな鼻、淡いピンクの唇。顔を正面のカメラへ向け、口を閉じた親しみのある微笑み。長いまつ毛、細いアイライン、両頬のはっきりした桃色の血色。黒に近いダークブラウンの髪を後頭部の高めで無造作なお団子にまとめ、薄い前髪と頬に沿う細い後れ毛を残す。

服装・ポーズ：
アイボリーの細リブ生地、胸元の小さなレース縁と中央の編み上げリボンがある細肩紐の短丈トップ、黒い柔らかなフレアミニスカート、裸足。畳に腰を下ろし、両膝を深く曲げて胸の前へ高く上げ、両足首を交差させて足裏を画面左上へ向ける。右腕を前から回して左脚の脛へ添え、左手も脚を支え、太腿の間から上半身が見える姿勢。

質感・スタイル：
暖かな朝の自然光で撮影した高精細なフォトリアルの実写写真。肌の自然なきめ、髪の後れ毛、リブトップとレース、黒い布、指と足裏、畳の編み目、障子紙、木、ガラス花瓶を写実的に描く。淡い木色、白、黒の落ち着いた配色で、過度な美肌加工やイラスト調を避ける。

交差した脚と足裏・手の支え・顔立ち・お団子髪の改変

Turning around overlooking a mountain lake

A single woman standing on a high rocky area in the center of the frame, looking back with her back turned. A deep blue mountain lake, coniferous forest, steep green mountain ranges, and a large summer sky spread out below.

Background/Light: 
Gray rocks in the foreground, coniferous forest and a long blue lake in the lower background, rock peaks and green slopes in the midground to upper part, with three-dimensional white clouds in a blue sky. Hard direct sunlight descends from the sun at the top right, creating sharp highlights and shadows on the person and the rocks.

Composition/Camera: 
Vertical 3:4, capturing the full body with a slightly low horizontal-leaning camera view. The person occupies a large portion from the center to the right, with a wide sky margin overhead and the lake crossing the lower half of the frame. Focus on the person while keeping the mountains and lake clear with deep depth of field.

Texture/Style: 
Photorealistic live-action photo taken in clear highlands. High-definition and natural high-saturation depiction of rocks, forest, water surface, sports fabric, and clouds.

Negative: 
Do not change the look-back over the shoulder to a front-facing standing pose; do not omit the three back straps.

prompt:
Subject:
White dress walking on ocean bubbles

A fantasy scene where a single woman in a sheer white dress walks toward the front through a shallow tropical sea in the center of the frame. Numerous transparent spheres of various sizes float in the air around her, each containing small fish, coral, shells, or jellyfish.

Person/Expression:
Her face is slightly upturned from the front, quietly gazing at the camera with lips slightly parted. Slender oval face, wide eyes and soft eyebrows, a straight nose bridge, pale coral lips, and thin pink cheeks. Clothing/Pose:
A white sheer long dress. Features a deep V-neck halter, fine drapes layered from the chest to the waist, a sash wrapped multiple times around the waist, a slit opening to the left thigh, and a long sheer hem. Arms are naturally lowered, and she steps forward with her left leg, creating a water splash.

Background/Light:
Transparent shallow water at the bottom, a turquoise sea and a green island in the back right in the background, and a deep blue sky with massive cumulonimbus clouds in the upper half. Harsh direct sunlight from above creates rainbow reflections and strong highlights on the transparent spheres, brightly illuminating the sheer white dress.

Composition/Camera:
3:4 vertical aspect ratio, showing the full body from a low horizontal eye level. The subject occupies most of the center, with massive spheres in the bottom-left and bottom-right foreground cut off at the edges, while small and medium spheres create depth around and above the subject. Focus on the subject while maintaining detail in nearby spheres, with only distant spheres slightly blurred.

Texture/Style:
Photorealistic live-action photography meets fantasy digital synthesis. Transparent glass spheres, water, coral, fish, sheer fabric, and clouds are rendered in high saturation and extreme detail.

Negative:
Do not leave the marine world inside the spheres empty; do not omit the sheer hem of the white dress

title: 超写实室内镜面自拍摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名年轻成年东亚女性坐在大型落地镜前的光
prompt:
超写实室内镜面自拍摄影，竖版约 3:4，一名年轻成年东亚女性坐在大型落地镜前的光滑灰色地面上，用手机对着镜子自拍。画面采用略高于人物的俯拍式镜面视角，人物位于画面左下至中央区域，上半部保留大量空旷的灰白色室内环境，双腿向画面右侧和右下方伸展，占据明显前景。采用约 24–28mm 等效手机广角镜头，镜面距离约 1–1.5 米，保持真实手机自拍产生的近大远小透视，不使用鱼眼，不做明显背景虚化。

人物拥有自然丰满、曲线明显的成年女性体型，上半身丰满，腰部明显收束，骨盆与髋部较宽，大腿丰满柔软。坐在地面后骨盆自然下沉，腰腹因屈髋形成轻微真实折叠，大腿因弯曲和互相接触产生自然软组织压缩。不要生成纤细模特体型，也不要使用夸张不符合人体结构的比例。

人物采用非常明显的低位坐姿：臀部坐在地面，身体略微向后倾，上半身朝镜子方向转动；两条腿同时抬离地面并屈膝，膝盖位于身体前方较高位置，形成不对称的折叠姿态。一条腿从身体中央向画面右侧斜向伸出，膝盖弯曲约 90°，另一条腿从下方交错穿过并向画面右下方延伸，使双腿形成层叠的 Z 字形结构。由于镜头距离很近，膝盖、小腿和脚部明显比上半身更靠近镜头，产生强烈但真实的广角前景透视。

人物双手共同握着一部深灰黑色智能手机，手机竖直位于脸部右前方、接近眼睛高度。右手从侧面握住手机，左手抬起贴近屏幕，一根手指像正在点击屏幕或按下快门。双肘自然弯曲并抬起，人物没有直视镜面，而是睁大双眼兴奋地看着手机屏幕。

人物留乌黑色中长直发，长度约到胸口下方，头发大部分自然垂落在背后和双肩两侧；额前为轻薄整齐的空气刘海，少量碎发贴近太阳穴和脸侧。脸型小巧偏鹅蛋形，下颌线柔和，深棕色大眼睛明显睁大，眉毛自然，鼻梁小巧。嘴巴明显张开，露出上排牙齿，形成非常自然的惊喜、兴奋笑容，脸颊带轻微粉红色腮红，整体表情活泼而有抓拍感。

上身穿纯黑色紧身无袖连体衣/短袖式运动连体服，上半部分为高圆领、贴身剪裁，袖口刚好覆盖肩部外缘，面料为哑光高弹力运动布料。衣服紧贴胸腰曲线，在腰部和髋部随坐姿产生轻微自然拉伸，不要出现夸张褶皱、亮面乳胶或皮革质感。

腿部穿黑色过膝长袜或腿套，从膝盖附近一直延伸至脚踝区域，面料厚实、哑光、有弹性。由于双膝弯曲，袜口在膝部附近形成自然卷边和压痕，小腿处布料保持贴合。双脚部分裸露，脚趾自然可见；其中一只脚靠近画面右下角，因广角透视略微放大，另一只脚位于画面最右侧并被边缘部分裁切。脚趾、脚掌与脚踝结构保持真实，不出现额外脚趾或扭曲。

场景是极简、空旷的现代室内空间，整体呈冷灰白色调。地面为大面积浅灰色光滑水泥或微水泥材质，具有轻微反射和不规则施工纹理；人物后方和上方是大面积浅灰白色墙体或可移动隔断板，隔断底部安装多个小型金属脚轮，距离地面留有一条狭长亮光。背景几乎没有家具和装饰，强调宽阔、干净、略带摄影棚或舞蹈练习空间的感觉。

镜面本身不需要明显边框，画面像直接通过大型落地镜拍摄。地面和镜面之间产生非常轻微的反射层次，但不要制造第二个人物或错误重复肢体。画面边缘允许自然裁切部分腿部和脚部，保持真实手机自拍构图，而不是刻意完整展示全身。

光线为明亮均匀的室内自然散射光与冷白环境灯混合，主要从画面上方和前方照射。人物脸部、双臂和大腿曝光明亮柔和，没有强烈硬阴影；黑色服装保持足够暗部细节。整体白平衡略偏冷，灰色空间带轻微青灰色调，皮肤仍保持自然偏暖，与背景形成柔和冷暖对比。

整体呈真实社交媒体手机自拍照片质感，高清但不过度商业化，轻微手机 HDR、自然锐化和少量压缩感。重点不是棚拍精致感，而是人物突然看到有趣内容后坐在镜前举手机拍摄的随意瞬间。

重点保持：空旷冷灰色极简室内＋大型落地镜自拍＋人物低位坐在地面＋明显俯视广角构图＋双腿同时抬起并大幅屈膝交错＋膝盖和小腿占据右侧前景＋双手竖握手机＋手指点击屏幕＋睁大眼睛看手机＋张嘴露齿的惊喜笑容＋黑色长直发与空气刘海＋黑色紧身无袖连体服＋黑色过膝长袜/腿套＋裸露脚部＋自然丰满体型＋真实手机随手拍质感。

避免：站姿、跪姿、普通盘腿坐姿、镜头平视、长裙、高跟鞋、丝袜高跟造型、纤细直筒体型、极端人体比例、腿部粘连、错误膝关节、额外腿、额外手臂、错误手指和脚趾、镜中重复人物、鱼眼畸变、强背景虚化、摄影棚硬光、过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、动漫脸、乱码文字、水印。

主題：
兎と灯りの晩餐

主体：
画面中央、夜のレストランのテーブルで、白いドレスの女性が丸い白兎のぬいぐるみを顔の横に持つ。手前の白い皿に盛られた料理、ワイングラス、蝋燭が晩餐の空気を作る。

人物・表情：
女性は顔を少し画面右へ傾け、カメラをまっすぐ見て穏やかな無表情。丸みのある卵形と小さな顎、大きな横長の目、細い緩い眉、小さく丸い鼻先、上唇は薄めで下唇は厚い赤みの唇。明るい肌に薄いピンクの目元とチーク。明るい栗色の肩丈ボブは中央寄りに分かれ、薄い前髪と内外に動く毛先がある。

服装・ポーズ：
アイボリーの細肩紐ワンピースで、低い胸元に細かなギャザー、ウエスト下に柔らかな切替とフリルがある。両肘をテーブルへ置き、両手で丸い兎のぬいぐるみを顔の左側に支える。細いネックレスとブレスレットを着ける。

背景・光：
前景に白い皿、銀のカトラリー、画面左にワイングラスと小さな花、背景に鏡面の店内、瓶、吊り下げ照明がある。画面左の蝋燭と上方の暖色光源が柔らかく顔と白い布を照らす。

構図・カメラ：
3:4の縦位置、座った人物を水平のカメラ視点で腰上まで大きく収める。兎は顔の左隣、料理皿は左下前景、人物とぬいぐるみにピントを合わせて背景の照明を玉ぼけにする。

質感・スタイル：
暖かな琥珀色の実写写真。柔らかなぬいぐるみ、サテン調の服、ガラスと料理の艶を精細に描く。

ネガティブ：
白兎のぬいぐるみを別の動物にしない

title: 超写实极简室内时尚人像摄影，一位20多岁的成年东亚年轻女性站在浅灰白色墙面前，竖
prompt:
超写实极简室内时尚人像摄影，一位20多岁的成年东亚年轻女性站在浅灰白色墙面前，竖构图，2:3比例，中景至大腿构图，人物位于画面中央偏左，占画面约70%。她身体以轻微三分之二侧面朝向画面右侧，背部轻靠墙面，腰部自然后仰并形成柔和S形曲线，一条腿微微向前跨出。左臂自然垂落并弯曲，左手轻触或捏住内裤侧边位置；右臂沿身体自然下垂。头部向画面右侧低垂，脸部大部分被长发遮挡，不直视镜头，整体姿态安静、克制、极简，带轻微私密感但不刻意摆拍。

她拥有纤细自然的身体比例，腰腹平坦但保留真实起伏和自然肚脐，不强调夸张腰臀。长而顺直的深棕黑色头发从偏侧分自然垂落至腰部附近，大量发丝覆盖脸侧和胸前，只隐约保留侧脸轮廓。发丝顺滑、厚实、有真实重量感，保留单根发丝与少量自然飞散。

她穿一套极简浅米色、灰米色或暖象牙色内衣。上身为运动型细肩带短款背心/soft bra crop top，圆形低领，较宽胸下弹力带，面料为柔软弹力针织或细密棉质，哑光、无纹样、无Logo。下身为同色低腰无痕三角内裤，剪裁简洁，腰线贴合髋骨，面料轻薄柔软，保持真实布料张力和自然褶皱。

背景极简，仅有浅灰白色墙面和极弱的垂直结构线条，没有家具、道具或杂物。画面右侧有一片明亮但柔和的窗光或漫射自然光，左侧略暗，形成非常轻微的冷暖和明暗渐变。

使用大型窗光或超大柔光箱从画面右前方照射，光线极其柔软、低反差，在肩膀、胸腹、腰线和大腿上形成平滑渐变。人物左侧和墙面保持柔和阴影，避免硬轮廓光和强烈戏剧化灯光。整体低饱和、低对比度、高明度，主色为冷灰白、暖米色、自然肤色和深棕发色，带日系极简写真、韩系美容广告和柔雾电影感。

使用85mm或105mm人像镜头，f/2–2.8，ISO 100–200，1/200s，浅至中等景深。头发、肩颈、腰腹、内衣面料和手指清晰，墙面平滑柔化。保留真实皮肤毛孔、自然肤色变化、真实腹部起伏、肚脐、单根发丝、针织纤维和布料张力。加入极轻微ISO 200胶片颗粒、柔和高光Bloom和轻微雾化感。避免塑料皮肤、过度磨皮、CG感、HDR、过锐化、极端细腰、夸张臀腿比例、错误手指、错误服装结构或额外肢体。整体风格：高级极简内衣编辑、自然窗光私密写真、日系柔雾人像，安静、干净、柔和、克制、自然。无文字、无Logo、无水印、无其他人物。

A young Korean woman in her twenties stands half-submerged at the edge of a secluded forest waterfall, her pale silver hair falling in soft, damp strands around her face and shoulders. She wears a white sleeveless mini dress of thin chiffon, the hem floating just above the waterline while the lower layers darken with wetness and billow in translucent folds downstream. Her skin is fair and luminous, lit by a soft, diffused key filtering through the canopy from the upper left, with delicate specular highlights along her damp jawline, collarbones, and shoulders. Her expression is unhurried and inward, with relaxed brows, slightly parted lips, and half-lidded eyes drifting off to the side rather than meeting the viewer.

Her pose is shaped by direct contact with the environment. She leans her back against a moss-covered boulder at the waterfall's edge, her shoulders pressed gently into the stone and her head tilted back so the spray catches along her jaw and throat. One arm rests along the rock beside her, her palm flat on the wet surface and fingertips trailing into the rushing water at the seam where stone meets current. Her other hand lightly gathers a fistful of floating chiffon against the flow, the fabric pulling taut between her fingers and the water. Her legs are slightly apart for balance, knees softly bent, bare feet planted on the slick, pebbled riverbed visible through the clear surface. Ripples spread from her hips outward, and small eddies curl around her calves. The body conforms to the rock and the flow rather than resisting them, giving the pose a surrendered, meditative weight.

The setting is a quiet natural pool beneath a tall, narrow waterfall cascading down a dark, fern-draped cliff face. title: 夜道のベージュドレス
prompt:
主題：
夜道のベージュドレス

主体：
人物は画面中央左に大きく置く。街灯の続く夜の路地で、ベージュのミニドレスを着た女性が黒いチェーンバッグを持って歩く縦位置写真。人物を左、濡れたように光る暗い道路を右に大きく配置する。

人物・表情：
顔を画面右下へ向けて視線を落とし、落ち着いた横顔を見せる。なだらかな卵形の輪郭、横長の目、細く自然な眉、まっすぐな鼻筋、淡いコーラルの唇。長い濃茶髪は前髪なしの横分けで、肩と背中へまっすぐ流れる。

服装・ポーズ：
細い肩紐と深いVネックのベージュ色リブニット・ボディコンミニドレス。画面左側の裾に細いドローストリングが垂れる。細いネックレスとブレスレットを着け、人物自身の右手で金色チェーンの黒いキルティングバッグを低く持つ。片脚を前へ出して歩く。

背景・光：
画面左の壁灯を柔らかな主光とし、画面右の道路と背景の街灯を暗く残す。左に間接照明の入った濃い壁、右に店舗と街路樹、奥へ続く黒い道路と小さな白い灯り。暖色の壁灯が肌とドレスを照らし、背景は青黒い夜色に沈む。

構図・カメラ：
カメラの焦点は人物に置き、頭から腿までを画面端で裁切し、背景を自然にボケさせる。人物を左半分に大きく見せる。3:4に近い縦構図、頭から腿までの中景。人物を左三分の一に置き、右側の道路に深い奥行きと余白を残す。自然な目線より少し低く、遠景の灯りを柔らかくぼかす。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルな実写写真。夜のスナップ感を残した高精細な実写。細かなリブ、バッグのキルティング、道路の反射と暖冷の光を自然に描く。

ネガティブ：
バッグを画面右へ移さない

title: 陽だまりに閉じる瞳
prompt:
【GPT Image2プロンプト】

主題：
陽だまりに閉じる瞳

主体：
人物は画面中央に大きく置く。白いベッドの上で、女性が顔を大きく上へ反らし、目を閉じて朝日を受ける縦位置の近接写真。顔、首、肩、白いレースの胸元を画面いっぱいに見せる。

人物・表情：
顎を高く上げて目を閉じ、艶のある唇をわずかに開く。丸みのある卵形の輪郭と滑らかな顎、長い閉じまつ毛、緩やかな眉、細い鼻筋と小さな鼻先、上唇より下唇がやや厚い淡いピンクの唇。明るい艶肌に薄い桃色の頬。長い茶髪は薄い前髪と顔周りの細い毛を残して背後へ流れる。

服装・ポーズ：
細い白い肩紐と繊細なレース縁を持つ白いキャミソールドレス。上体を後ろへ預け、肩を開き、顔から首の縦線を強調する。細い金色のネックレスを着ける。

背景・光：
画面右上の窓方向から硬い直射光を入れる。白い毛足のある寝具、左奥の小卓に丸い暖色ランプと淡い花。画面右上から硬めの朝日が差し、顔と肩に明るい斜光、壁と寝具に濃い影を落とす。

構図・カメラ：
カメラの焦点は顔に置き、胸上から頭までを画面端で裁切し、背景を自然にボケさせる。顔を中央に大きく見せる。3:4の縦構図、胸上から頭頂までの極端なクローズアップ。仰いだ顔を上半分の中央に置き、首と胸元を下へ伸ばす。近距離のわずかな俯瞰で、背景は大きくぼける。

質感・スタイル：
フォトリアルな実写写真。肌の光沢、レース、唇、髪を高精細に写す暖色の実写美容写真。直射光の強い明暗差を保つ。

ネガティブ：
目を開けない；顔の上向き角度を浅くしない
